I strongly recommend the the migas (a yummy southwest-style scramble that includes crushed up corn tortilla chips) the bagel plate, and the special sandwiches which someone else also praised.  The juices are not cheap, but if you are battling a hangover or just feeling crappy, an apple, orange, and carrot juice and a plate of migas will set you right.  Cash only. Service is efficient, but not much else. During my first experience, when they were very busy, it was impossible to get anything, especially coffee refills.

I've been here a few times now, each time I'm in town I try to stop here. The food is good and verbally the device is good as well. However, tonight's visit in was a bit confusing...

I entered the restaurant around 5:45pm, and upon entering there were three people seated inside, a couple in the back corner eating and a lady at the bar eating. Standing there for about 30 seconds or so, unsure if I should wait to be seated or seat myself, a woman in the back of the restaurant started yelling something towards the front of the place. I thought I did something wrong. 

She yelled something again and the guy in the corner turned and looked at me and went back to eating, once more she yelled and then he finally got up confused looking and started walking to the woman at the bar... and again the lady in the back yelled, he finally seems to notice me, and as he looked at me, confused, he said "oh?". At this point I looked at him and said: "Just one please". He still seemed confused as to why he was helpin me but told me to just sit anywhere. He followed me to the table and gave me a menu. Then immediately walked away.

A minute or two later he came back to get my drink order, to which I ordered water. When he returned with the drink he sat the water down with the woman at the bar, she said "this isn't for me, I think that's his drink." Pointing at me...

He then smiled and was like "oh yeah." Picking the drink back up and bringing it to me. He then just stood there, not saying anything - I took this as my queue to order so I pointed to what I wanted and said that I also wants to add an egg roll. Fairly quickly the food came out. Thankfully he not only brought the food to me but he also brought me the right food, with one exception - no egg roll. But after quickly setting it food down he darted outside for about 10'minutes - I believe he was trying to bring in customers who were walking by as he finally returned inside with a small group of people. 

At this point he takes care of their order then brings me a check. $30 with a soda, beer, and two meals on it, and again goes right back outside before I can even pick the ticket up to look over it. Not in a rush I waited a bit, sipped my water. He returned 6-8 minutes later and comes to collect the check. I tell him it's the wrong check.

He smiles and apologizes and comes back with another check. This time it had the correct meal but also had a $2.50 charger for a soft drink, to which I pointed down at my cup of water and told him that I only had a water and that there was a soda charge on the bill. He grabs it back and looks at it for a few seconds and then says he will be right back. 

At this point he finally brings the right check, my card was still in my hand but he darted off again before I could hand it back to him. So  walked up to the bar, near the register and stood there for about 5 minutes before someone would ring it out. At this point there were two tables with 5 total people and the woman at the bar, not a crazy rush by any standards. 

Paid and left... I will definitely think twice about returning, sadly.

We really enjoyed our experience here. The food was really good and so was the beer. The service was friendly. 

We really liked the cheesesteak egg rolls for the appetizer. I ordered the burger of the day from their promotional May burger menu and it was great. My wife ordered the chicken ceasar salad which she loved. The only complaint we have was the strawberry mojito was awful. 

We will definitely go back.
Ok ride, food not worth the price. Not much to see along the Mississippi but other ships and warehouses.  Save your money for an Airboat ride.

I went here with some friends while visiting for the weekend, I am extremely pleased with everything about this place. From the decor, vibe, music (DJ was playing old soul music and R&B that hit every chord in the right way). The portions were grand, I feel like there are often many spots that don't get it right or overcharge for basics, not here. I loved everyone else's dishes too (literally since the place settings are a mixture of types / designs of plates). Their biscuits are SOOOOOO good, make SURE you get them. I had the cheesy grits with shrimp hands down awesome & prepared the right way (and I'm picky since I go to ATL a lot), they get it right here! Absolutely coming back here for my next brunch when I'm in town!

I visited Kei twice this week! This is my new favorite spot in town!  The menu has an awesome mix of traditional rolls you know and love and some new and interesting rolls I haven't seen on any other menu in town. 

My favorite roll is probably the Tiburon- salmon, spicy tuna, pickled jalapeño, daikon and sesame seeds. 

The service was awesome too! I sat at the bar and my plates were cleared quickly and my drink was always full. I can't wait to come back for more to try the specialty nigiri!
More of a tourist site than a place to go for value and good food.  Don't get me wrong as the shell fish is good and fresh but very expensive and terrible atmosphere.

I frequent this Subway cause it's close to my house. The place is clean enough, and the food was average for a Subway restaurant. However the older gentlemen who appears to be Indian is very cold and unpleasant. Oh, and EXTREMELY stingy with the food and toppings! He literally sparkled like 2 pinches of cheese on my sandwich, and I feel like I was shorted on everything else too......won't be going back unless I can help it.

The reason I came here was because I drop my car in the body shop next door. Service is way too slow!!! We wait an hour for our food to come out!!! Sushi is decent but others are terrible. Especially Beef teriyaki. Avoid this place unless you don't have a choice.

Over all the food is good my problem  with this location is they just bring out a few bread sticks for 4 people They brought out enough salad for one person I order Alfredo boat for the bread sticks and there definitely wasn't 1/3 cup in there I told my waitress and she said they got new management and they don't want them giving much no more I will go to the chesterfield location from now on they give you your money's worth

For those who must eat GF, this place is a dreamland. I brought home some of the brownies and donuts and my family quickly devoured them. The assortment of baked goods seemed pretty extensive and I will definitely be coming back soon.

McCree Town used to be one of the finest crack neighborhoods in the area. And now look what's become of it....

This is a gorgeous space with gorgeous baked delicacies. The macarons are fabulous. At first I did think, how crazy is it to put an authentic Patisserie in an area like this and not Clayton? But you know what? We deserve beauty here, too.
I found the staff very pleasant and willing to help, and saw Simone Faure, the pastry chef (who I think looks very much like my favorite chanteuse Nina Simone) greeting each customer. Maybe the opening weeks were stiff and formal, but they have settled in nicely. So go get a strawberry macaron or a chocolate bombe or a beautiful croissant and be thankful. We are very lucky to have Simone grace us with her skills.

The food here is above what you would get in the Quarter. They make their own hot sausage and the french toast is on point. The owner was kind , but his brother was AWESOME! He was really cool and just made us feel so welcome!It's a family run business and I dig that. The servers were excellent and made great suggestions. They make sure to thank you for your business and appreciate it as well. Just a great group of people in there. I have eaten at several restaurants here and this is the only one I felt deserved a five star review.

Laughably HORRIBLE, overly SALTY mexican food. Go to Mi Pais or El Limón or El Charro Negro and eat AUTHENTICO! I ordered a dish and my friend was with me, the older woman who helped us BARELY spoke english and even though my friend did not want anything, she put him down for an order of something else on the menu! Then she was unable to understand that I WOULD NOT PAY for that, so she charged me ANYWAY without telling me. So i paid for 2 meals. One of which I DID NOT EVEN CONSUME! STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE! There are so many better latin cuisine options, i don't know why this place is STILL in existence!!!
Nasty flavor. Very sloppy presentation. Empty on Thursday night. Never again. Best part was the serve staff.

The double butter burger is by far one of my favorites. The good news is I can eat half and share my other half with someone who wants just a little more. The burgers are thin (not as thin as steak n shakes) and the ends are crispy that is why I like half of a double   It's perfect!!  And the concrete mixers.. Make ur own shake!!! We get a vanilla ice cream base with a little chocolate caramel and coconut added. Yes these are our fat day meals. Lol

I love Milktooth  the food is absolutely amazing atmosphere is fun and  after my first visit I couldn't wait to go back.
I am very pleased that they serve their most beautiful and incredible coffee with a milk substitute. I love coffee and chocolate but after a certain age  I have had  to be very careful about the amount of caffeine my body can tolerate.  After my first visit I was up until 2 am but still couldn't wait to go back. Crazy about  this place!!!
Unfortunately after my visit at ~9 am this am I'm still awake. Even so, I am hopeful that someday decaf will be served. This is the only reason I only gave them 3 stars. It seems simple that I just wouldn't order coffee but I don't have that kind of will power
Fantastic cinnamon rolls according to my kid. I had the Denver omelet which was great. The coffee was good. I liked the patio seating.

I genuinely question the sanity of anyone who does not absolutely love this place. This is one of the most outstanding places I have ever eaten, and I am often tempted to drive the 6+ hours to NOLA just to get a box of their donuts. 
District donuts does not mess around. There's a line around the block for this place for very good reason. Not because it's hip or trendy or an Instagram fad, but because it's actually THAT good. Have you ever had a croque monsieur or madame made with a donut instead of boring old bread? Have you ever watched someone brulee a cinnamon roll to somehow make it even more amazing? I bet you didn't even know that it was possible to brulee a cinnamon roll, did you?! Well, now you know. And you should try it immediately. 
This place is so many of my dessert dreams come true. I cannot wait to visit again!

Let me start with the bathrooms. Where my brother went to grab toilet paper and stuck his hand in a massive amount of shit. Where my wife and sister in law some poop smeared all over the toilets. Let me continue on with the food. The Mongolian bar had shrimp with the chicken, what about people with an allergy to shrimp? Or how about the noodles that smelled sour. Let's not forget to mention the chicken was either cold and gross and/or contained nothing but fat. OH! The chocolate pudding had big yellow chunks of food in it! What was left of the ice cream was slimy! Then not only did it already cost $40 just for my family of 4 (2 adults and 2 children) but they helped themselves to a pre tip of $4, something called a "gratituity" and then asked for an additional tip. Wouldn't have been a problem IF someone helped. Although they were quick to pick up my credit card, my table was piled with dishes. This place is disgusting and I'm half tempted to call someone to inspect their filth filled restaurant. Never going again
Decor is awesome. Service was impeccable. It was Mexican cuisine with a French twist. I recommend give  this quaint and trendy spot a try...

The place was dead when we got there and there we're more ppl working than customers in the restaurant. The service was pathetic and the food was extremely mediocre. Should have gone to Denny's next door, that's how much of a waste a time this place is

I love this place! Freshest food is always worth the money! I'm a huge fan of the Fa La La La La-roasted turkey, house made cranberry sauce, baby swiss, lettuce and tarragon mayo, and I get mine on the pretzel ciabatta. Mmmm! Salads are always heaped with tons of the good stuff-greens, avocado, eggs, fruit, nuts....whatever it's topped with, there's always more than enough (in a good way!) And the tea there is absolutely fantastic! Always cold and refreshing!  To wrap up your meal and satiate your sweet tooth-huge chocolate chip cookies! Sometimes it gets a little crowded in the dining area, but in the restaurant biz, I guess that's a good thing!  I only don't care for the awkwardness of sitting at the side tables near the windows; if someone is at the table next to you, it's like sitting on their lap...yikes! but that's the only complaint I have! Overall, love the atmosphere and the food is super!

I brought the general's chicken (white meat) it was awful. The chicken was fried so hard that I couldn't eat it, but my dog liked it. The rib tips were ok. Also, I had shrimp fried rice, which wasn't too bad except some of the shrimp were mushy. Well to make a long story short, I won't be getting anything else from there.

A better follow up experience today.  Mr. Shula, I'm a hostage at the hotel so you have a captive audience.

So, I stopped by for a quick lunch.  Took a while to get a server but once that happened, she was attentive.  Ordered the Chicken Sandwich (I know it's a Steak House but they don't have lunch sized portions).  It came in a reasonable amount of time.  Brioche bun was good, tomato and onion were fresh.  Butterflying the chicken seems to make for a better sandwich but the breast was cooked well none the less.

Better experience but wish they had a lunch specific smaller option on the steaks.

It was a great pub! There was a decent selection of beers, including some local brews. The cheesesteak was tasty and Christmas chicken was surprisingly good. Plenty of seating inside, with fast and attentive service. Overall, it was a good pick for a stay in Philly.

I was really excited to go to Ants Pants and I'll be back.  I was definitely not as impressed as I wanted to be.  I loved the clean aesthetic.  I loved the coffee and the sweet potato fries with chile sauce rock.  

I was saddened to see the manager snap at the new dishwasher.  I know that happens and people get stressed, but I just had a sense that entire staff was really busy and morale seemed low. The breakfast burrito I ordered lacked major flavor.

I will go back because I think it might have been an off day.
I would have to say that this is our new favorite Thai restaurant in Boise. The price is a bit higher but worth it. We have tried a number of dishes and have not been disappointed.

Three stars is the highest I can give chains, I do make exceptions. This Outback is great, servers are super friendly, foods is consistent and in a pinch when I can't get to my favorite steak place their ribeye is great. I eat my steak Pittsburgh rare and they know how to cook it.

Tried this place out for dinner the other night and was pleasantly surprised. They have such a fun and creative menu. I can't wait to try something else they offer. I also love that their menu has a really fun sense of humor to it as well (check out how they can slice your pizza) we got the mooseknuckle which was just pepperoni and pineapple and an order of wings. 

The pizza crust was cooked perfectly and the sauce was flavorful. Everything worked well together... and the pizza was not overly greasy which is always a plus. The wings were delish... I wish they came in weight and not number (you can get an order of 6 or 12) we got the Buffalo flavor and it was super tasty. 

This is a smaller place kind of tucked away in the back, they do not deliver so you'll have to pick up. There isn't much room to dine in but there are seats inside and outside. Will definitely eat here again.

The pizza is good. The best in Hendersonville in my opinion. But the place is seemingly run by a bunch of high schoolers that play around way too much. For the price of this pizza, a pleasant customer experience shouldn't be too much to ask for.

I need to go to this place a few more times to try their different stuff.. but the doubles (chickpea stew sandwiched between 2 puffy flatbreads) I had there were a great little afternoon snack.  $1.50 each and you could have 3 for a totally legit lunch.. maybe 2 if you are eating light.  They also have roti with all different meats including shrimp and "soya" and other standard West Indian fare like curry goat, collard greens, etc.  Plates of those things range in price and size from about $5 up.  I am giving 4 stars just because doubles I've had in the past were a little more substantial, and they could have been spicier (though they were well-spiced, just not hot). The thing I was most disappointed by was  the subpar ginger-pineapple juice I got for $3.  $3!?  But I think that was more my fault than theirs.

btw this is a storefront bakery setup with a window in the back with the hot dishes to order.  There are a couple of tables in there too but it's not a nice-lunch-out sort of place.

The food was pretty good. The wait for my chicken was really long, I had to wait for 25 mins just for chicken slices. They didn't have a lot of sauce for the shrimp but it was pretty good. It only took 10 mins for the shrimp to come out.

We've just had dinner at Eatalia for the 2nd time in the last 3 months and each time, our meal has been delicious.  The quality and consistency of the cooking and the creative daily specials really makes this place a true "find", in my opinion.  

Just a few minutes off I-95, it's easier to get here than to most restaurants in Center City or South Philly and the free street parking couldn't be any easier.  Overall, this is a comfortable, reasonably priced, unassuming neighborhood BYOB which has become one of my new favorites.

Best burritos in the city, hands down. The tortillas are far better than Chipotle and Qdoba. They're freshly-made, warm, and stretchy. I would buy one just for a snack. The Bob, a plastic mixing tool, is wonderful. Gone are the days of big rice-only bites. The manager has always been kind to us. My wife and I just came in to redeem our free frequent customer burrito. The staff cut it in half for us and offered a little cup of salsa to me, as my wife eats her burritos salsa-less. (A tragedy, right?!) Give this fairly new-to-Indy chain some love!

Love at 425 degrees!  We decided to have pizza last night and to take advantage of their $10 for any large pizza deal.  We got the Murphy's combo minus olives.  The gal that took my order was friendly and efficient, though she quoted my total due incorrectly twice, but it was funnier than bothersome.  She told me that the pizza would be ready within 5 minutes.  I took a seat and before the seat was warm my name was being called to pickup the pizza.  I cooked the pie for 14 minutes (recommended is 12-18), which cooked it perfectly.  There were plenty of toppings, cheese and a nice golden brown crust.  The only knock on the pie was the sauce, which had issues with consistency of spices.  Of the few slices that we had, we would occasional get a heavy dose of Italian spices.  I love spice in my sauce, but it was a bit overwhelming.  We will go back for the deal, as there isn't a better pizza deal in town, when you just want something quick to make at home.

My family was in town visiting, so I decided to take them out to Philadelphia. It was a first time for all of us. We went to Spruce Street Harbor Park to enjoy the nice lights and drinks they have there during the summer. It was close to 11pm by the time we were walking back to our car and we never had dinner (because we had a late lunch), so we decided to see if there was anything open nearby we could eat at before getting in our car to drive home. We first stopped by 2nd Story, but they already stopped serving food by then, so we asked if they knew of any place still serving food nearby. This is the place he recommended.

At first sight, this place looks like a dingy bar, and we weren't sure what to expect. While it is a pub (and the restrooms will remind you of that), the food was amazing! I wasn't sure if I'd be able to find anything for myself, being that I'm a vegetarian, but they had numerous vegan options, even vegan desserts! However, I opted for the nachos off the appetizer menu. As ecstatic as I was that they were vegan-friendly, the vegan options were things like bbq pulled pork, bbq ribs, etc. None of which I ever ate as a carnivore, so even though it was vegan, I wasn't interested. You'd think of all the vegan stuff they had, and all the normal stuff they normally serve at pubs, they'd have a veggie burger, but oh well. The nachos weren't bad (although, I prefer nacho cheese, rather than melted cheese because melted cheese tends to harden quickly). I also got the sweet potato bisque off of their specials menu and that tasted like baby food, so I wouldn't recommend that if you ever see that on the menu.

I had some of the sides my family got with their orders and the mashed potatoes and mac n cheese are amazing! If I ever end up here again, I am definitely going to just order myself a bunch of sides. I also tried their collared greens, which were good as well. Everyone at my table enjoyed their meals, and they give you decently large portions. Walking into this pub was a nice surprise. It reminds you not to ever judge a book by it's cover.

We were not impressed. The eight dollar guacamole that had crema or sour cream added was not good. I had a fish taco that tasted fishy. Not good either. The Rollo Pollo wasn't bad, nor were either of the salmon dishes. My husband ordered enchiladas and he was not impressed. Very pricey for the quality or lack thereof.

Great place to have some small bites and some local beer! 
I had the charcuterie plate and it was wonderful. It should be split to allow you to try different things. I will do that next time. The rest of the menu looked great as it passed by me on the way to other tables. 
If there had to be a highlight in this wonderful place it would be Nick the bartender/waiter who made me feel welcome and gave great advice on dinner. 
Will be back in Nashville and hope to share this gem with my lovely wife!

I went here a few days ago ignoring the warnings from my coworkers that this place had bad sushi. But I went and was disappointed. They have the saltiest rice and the sushi seems like processed fish. I feel like they just get some frozen fish and grind it up and make the sushi.

I had the lunch special with Tom Yum soup, fresh spring rolls, and tofu Pad Thai all for a little more $11.

Everything was really yummy and up to my standards. 

I have no complaints other than service was pretty slow but friendly. Either they need an extra person during lunch time on a Thursday afternoon or she simply was not attentive and proactive enough.

For the sake of the food and just more patience needed (or merely hoping for better service next time), I definitely would like to come back again.

I always liked cracked barrel  but today was the worst! 
wait time to give your name so they can get a table  ready 15minutes. We get seated and wait 20 to 30 just to get our food we ordered. took our waitress 15 minutes just to come to our table to apologize for the wait time.
We finally get our plates and one was warm and the other was cold,they take the plate back to kitchen and replace the pancakes and rest were put in a microwave,let's just say the eggs,sausage and bacon was rubber

Great local place with some neat pizza combinations.  The Chicken Bacon Ranch pizza is fantastic.  The Mac & Cheese Grilled Cheese is tasty.  Not a huge fan of the giant glob of Mozzarella on the top of the pulled pork mac & cheese though.  Delivery is super smooth and the delivery people are always really nice.  The staff inside the restaurant are also very pleasant.

The fish tacos are my go to item here. There is a self serve salsa bar. The quality of some of the stuff in the salsa could definitely be better but it's not too big of a deal. I have also tried the carne asada and the chicken tacos. They are also pretty good.

ACAI BOWL HEAVEN! I was recently in Santa Barbara for a stop during a road trip, and I decided to quench my endless desire for acai bowls at Backyard Bowls. As a die-hard acai bowl lover, I was so happy to find this awesome spot!

I ordered the Cocoa Almond Bowl (honestly tasted better than most chocolate ice cream), and my sister ordered the Green Bowl (kale, spinach, acai, ginger goodness--get this if you like ginger!). Both were absolutely amazing! Definitely a bit on the pricey side, but we ate them for lunch and one bowl was more than enough to fill up one person. I recommend coming here with a friend and splitting a bowl!

All in all, one of the best acai bowls I've ever had. Next time I'm in Santa Barbara, I will definitely stop by again at Backyard Bowls!

Went here for lunch while looking at some houses in the area. The brunch menu was straight forward, we had a grilled cheese and chicken salad sandwich with some fries. With tip we spent $50, pretty expensive grilled cheese and chicken salad. Looking back you could better spend $50 to feed yourself, highway robbery. Plenty places in the area for food, I would stay away this place must have some expensive rent to be charging $15 for a grilled cheese.

I'm new to the all you can eat option in sushi restaurants.  So the waitress gave us her pitch and after everyone took off their shoes to figure out the math we decided to go for it.  Save yourself the math and go for the all you can eat.  Even if you are not a big eater the variety is worth it.

I've been here 5-6 times over the last couple years. I stay at the pear tree inn when going to Barnes Jewish so it's pretty convenient. The food is above average and I've always had great service. I do not like the signature wing sauce, it's very musterdy. But, everything else is good and the homemade marinara sauce is out of this world.

Thursday night at 7pm shouldn't be too bad right???? NOPE! 25 minutes so far in the drive thur! Two cars still ahead of me and it's not like I can just leave. Love Del Taco but you are turning into Taco Bell with this crap!
This place is authentic Italian. It's just the right size and isn't loud inside. Waiter was fantastic. Very enjoyable to dine here. Food is fabulous.

What a disaster. Bad food and terrible service. 
The waitress was rude throughout, leaving the area before we even finished ordering. I ordered a waffle with blueberries and my friend ordered French toast with strawberries. When they mixed up the fruits on each, the waitress told us to just pick the fruit off and trade, so instead of taking it back and fixing the order, she watched us pick each individual blueberry and strawberry off and trade. It just went downhill from there. I'm not even wasting my energy on typing anymore. I will never return to this establishment again.
Great choice for a fast, healthy, low cal meal. I made my own salmon bowl. Feta, avocado, spinach,  egg, and almonds. So many greens I thought I was on a golf course.

Please don't let a couple of the negative reviews here turn you away from this really neat spot!! Honestly, our group eats out a lot and have high dining expectations. We saw no evidence of their complaints. There was a full house tonight, and we still had a wonderful experience here! We were greeted warmly by the hostess and seated immediately. Our server and buster were awesome---warm and super nice, just attentive enough with perfect timing and no rushing. Great wine list and really good craft cocktails. Calamari and caprese salad were delicious, as was the spaghetti and meatballs and veal chop with hasselback potatoes. We all shared the appetizer and dessert (tiramisu) because the portions here for every course are HUGE!! It was a bit too chilly to enjoy the beautiful courtyard, but we will be back! They also offer valet parking now! Amazing---

I would give it zero stars if I could. The employees looked liked they hated their lives and did not care. It's labeled as bbq, but elementary school cafeteria bbq is a far more accurate description. If flavorless mush is what your after then hit this place up, if you want bbq, drive the extra distance and go to Martins bbq!

I love the sturdy buns which provide an excellent foil for the classic and/or inventive toppings. The Cincinnati Skyline may be the best chilli and cheese topping I've ever had and if you ask, they will put it on their excellent frites. My one beef with this place is, in fact, the beef - they use all-beef Sabbrett franks and I just don't like all-beef dogs. I wish they would add a pork/veal Vienna-style frank. They already offer a veggie dog option, so what's one more? Also, $6 is a little pricy for what you get, but I don't mind paying extra for quality. Just get some porky dogs! Oh, and little pickled hot peppers for the Chicago dog - even Sonic uses those.

Fantastic prices, authentic Mexican fast food that is high quality. My husband loves the octopus and shrimp ceviche. I love the vegetarian quesidilla, and we both think that the homemade hot sauce on the table is delicious. Great prices and amazing food...you cannot go wrong here.

Best authentic Mexican food ever.   

It's run by a family of people from Oaxaca  (a state in southern Mexico) and the food is just Amazing.  
**Make sure to bring CASH**
Great burgers (especially the gator burger) and very good seasoned fries! the jambalaya was ok and the kettle chips were pretty good but the fries were better

I initially visited a year ago at the recommendation of my Airbnb host and it was well worth the second visit this time around. The food is still amazing! The dining space is small/intimate but homey and the customer service is amazing. I will definitely plan to come back when I'm back in town.

Indian food has been one of my favorites for quite a few years. Still new to town, I took my family out to find a good Indian restaurant. One of my coworkers told me to check this place out. We should have taken it as a sign when we walked into the place and it was completely empty, then we had to wait a couple minutes for someone to come out of the kitchen and notice we were there. The food wasn't awful, but it was FAR from good. We had the lunch buffet, so we tried a little of everything, but nothing at all was worth going back to try again. I'll never go back.

So a vegetarian walks into a meat-centric restaurant... and a four star review ensues? Yep, that's right. I like The Block a lot! Everything I've had here has been good. I've been a handful of times. The only thing I wish they had was one more vegetarian entree on the menu for variety. 

I love the happy hour here. Great drinks and food specials. My favorites are the fries and the soft pretzels with cheese sauce. Both delicious!! 

For lunch or dinner, their salads are great. They always have a special salad and it doesn't always include meat, but if so, they can modify it. Their salad dressings are great and ingredients really fresh. Half or whole portions are available for all appetites. Their mac n cheese is a good option but it was missing something to make it a little more flavorful. I loved the cheese on top. 

They have house made desserts, which are amazing!! Their homemade ice cream is to die for. Really. Don't miss it. 

Service is always good. 

I'll be back!

Excellent food 
Great customer service
Affordable
Lovely ambience

Visited here during a business trip and I was not disappointed in one aspect of my experience. From the warm, inviting atmosphere to the friendliness displayed here, I felt nothing less than special.

I always look for authentic places with unique experiences and this was definitely a great choice. I will definitely be coming back when I'm back in town. Meanwhile,  I'm just going to take some to go...back to NC!

My favorite dish was the Brown Stew Chicken...delicious!

BBQ sandwich is one of the best I've had.  Tender, not overly spiced/sauced pulled pork.  Real deal BBQ.  Short drive from my house.  Just far enough to keep the weight off.  Great burgers, too!  

BigCity
www.bigcityrocks.com

Love this place!  Been coming here for years and it has only gotten better over the years.  They have delicious gluten free bread for their fresh sandwiches and quite often their soup of the day is gluten free.  The coffee is delicious, so are the shakes.  The decor is warm and local art is always hanging on the walls.  Staff is friendly and helpful and dogs are welcome, so that's always a plus!

From the moment you walk in, you know this place appreciates your business. Service from Len is top notch. Food was great, especially the trio of soups. Really enjoyed the grilled fish on pecan rice and hubby loved the bacon wrapped shrimp. Highly recommend. We walked in without reservation in a Sunday. Great start to our week in NOLA.
Pop music on the poor quality, tinny sound system. Hibachi was good but it's cooked in the back. Sushi was better. Decent food but without good atmosphere a place can't be fun. That's my $0.02

On my way too work I decided to check out this little whole in the wall cafe.

I am glad I did. Unlike so many uppity places I have been to here in New Orleans most of the regulars were blue collar workers.The waitresses were not wearing uniforms, they were wearing there street clothes. Your classic Diner/Dive restaurant. In other words my favorite kind of place.

When I went in I was greeted by a friendly waitress. Well she was more flirty than anything else but that didn't bother me. In fact I kinda liked it. ;)

The food they serve here is breakfast/lunch which is available 24/7. They sell doughnuts and other pastries.They have a drive thru window too.This morning I had some breakfast. What I had was one egg,hash browns,bacon and a biscuit. The one thing that I ecstatic about was how they did my eggs. I asked for eggs over medium, and guess what. They got it right! Its only the second place here in  NOLA that has succeeded in getting that right. Before I left I tried one of their doughnuts. A Boston creme pie doughnut I believe, simply delicious! All that food,my orange juice and even the tip it was still under $10 dollars.

In short this place has a lot going for it. Great service,great food,open 24/7,very cheap prices and it is incredibly close to the Job site. With all of these great incentives they definitely have a repeat customer.

Indoor range, very friendly staff who don't mind teaching you the proper techniques.  They offer overview instructions of what to expect and eye gear and ear protection are included in your range fee.  They offer a great selection of gun gear to purchase.  Would definitely visit again!

Was really looking forward to coming here, but just wasn't that impressed with the food.  It was okay, but I think there are much better options for ramen just a 10 minute walk away on Washington Ave.  The waitstaff were all very friendly, and the place has potential.

Holy moly this is one of the best places to eat in Indy! So cheap and soooo good! I always get the Maque Choux which is made with corn and chicken. It's not spicy at all and pretty sweet. It's the perfect lunch or dinner. Oh, did I mention the garlic bread is the shiz?? Don't forget to brig cash or a check though because this Yatz does not take cards.

This is a great small business to support. We went in for fried shrimp po-boy and it was delicious! The staff was very friendly, and it was a good value. Definitely worth a stop if you are in that area. We'll try the soft-shell po-boy next time we're in NOLA.

Breakfast/ Brunch is our absolute favorite meal to eat out, so we were pretty excited to see the new pancake house open up across from the cherry hill mall. Upon arrival the restaurant was pretty empty.. we had the option to dine in or take out; so we picked a booth near the window. The waitress was very kind and walked us through the menu. 

We ordered Oreo pancakes, side of bacon and a Mediterranean omelet. The pancakes was fair, not special and the bacon was slightly over cooked. The real highlight of our meal was the omelet and crispy breakfast potatoes with peppers and onions! The omelet was thick and fluffy- highly recommend. We will definitely come back to try different omelets.
One of my fav place in St. Pete. This place doesn't need anymore reviews or business, but I love it so I had to leave 5 stars!

The service is excellent; they are incredibly attentive to their patrons seated at tables). They have an extensive bottle list (tons of beers, plus 2 ciders), and several on tap beers. The food is decent and came out fast, but I only had appetizers not a full dinner. On Saturday night, tables are only for dining. The atmosphere is very cozy, but it's very loud inside. It's in a sketchy neighborhood, but it's well worth it. I will definitely be going back!!!

Awesome place to chill and have a beer. Great rotating selection. You gotta have a mule, my favorite is the English Ass (gin), and they're 1/2 price on Mondays. You also can't go wrong with the pretzel sandwiches!

I haven't actually had a meal here yet, but I popped in for a few desserts this week, and everything was amazing! 
I took home a slice of strawberry cake, vanilla cheesecake, and a lemon bar. 
The triple layer strawberry cake was so beautiful, and big enough to share. My daughter loved it. I'm not a big icing fan, but she loved the cream cheese frosting and I loved the bite of cake she let me steal. 
The vanilla cheesecake was also a hit with my other daughter, but she thought it might have needed to be left out of the fridge a bit longer before serving. 
I had the lemon bar, which was the best I've ever had, with fresh lemon curd and a nice and crisp shortbread crust. I will have a hard time not stopping in for these every time I drive past! 
The proprietor served me, and was perfectly lovely. It's worth noting that she has excellent taste in food, beer, and wine. For such a limited menu the shop has a really amazing local beer and (not local ) wine selection. I was impressed. 
I can't wait to stop by for breakfast or lunch. They're not open for dinner, so go early! They close at 6.

This strip mall restaurant really confuses me. The inside is relatively small but clean and well kept. There was also outside seating available which is nice. On a Sunday afternoon there were about 6 tables occupied with 2 tables that were occupied by Hispanic people which is usually a good sign. My son and I were seated quickly and chips and salsa brought to the table. Tri-color chips? Really? The salsa was smooth and tomatoey. Drinks were brought out timely. On a Sunday early afternoon, 1 TV was on American football, 1 on European football (soccer), 1 on CNN and 2 on a camping show. The menu is huge. Too many choices.

I ordered their signature cilantro cream enchiladas and my son order the Monterey Quesadilla. The food came out fast. I mean unexpectedly fast. The quesadilla was rolled which I hadn't before and appeared to be heated on a flattop but it came out way to quick. My son said it was good. The cilantro cream enchiladas were just 2 small tortillas rolled with only precooked chicken chunks, no binders. Every time I cut the tortilla the chicken chunks pour out. The cream sauce was good but needed more cilantro. The enchiladas came with rice and black beans. The rice was pretty standard overcooked and dry. The black beans came in a tortilla cup and they had no flavor. They didn't even taste like beans. They had NO flavor. They were very confusing and I left them behind.

All-in-all, there must be something tasty on the menu with so many 4 and 5 stars but I didn't find it and I am not planning to go back and try to find out.

Lüke's happy hour is phenomenal. It is everyday from 3pm-6pm; don't miss it. Their raw oysters are 75¢ and fried ones are $1.25. All drinks are half off during happy hour, also. What a deal! To make matters better, the service, which at times seemed like multiple folks taking and providing our orders, is exceptional and very friendly. This was our first time eating raw oysters, and Lüke didn't disappoint. Make sure to make a reservation. We will be back.

Great food, and staff! It's their first day of business so they were out of some things that were on the menu and not all of their beer taps were up and running.  Not every opening is perfect I suppose.

Very small footprint inside, just a handful of seats at the bar.

I would have given 5 stars, but waiting 30 min for a sandwich and chips is not fun. Not sure if I showed up at the wrong time or what.

Will be back for dinner to try something else...

We had been wanting to stop in since they opened. The place was almost empty at 9:00pm on a Saturday night. Not a good sign. We decided to stay to have a beer and an appetizer. Reuben egg rolls were good. Beer was good, but too pricy for draught in my opinion. Atmosphere is horrible. This restaurant is across the street from the Winthrope Community, which has amazing food and service establishments and can not compete when sub par service is provided. I will not be back again. I can get better food and service at Eats across the street.
Breakfast. Good orange juice and tasty pancakes. Yummy, tasty toasted bagels with cream cheese also.

I love this coffee shop! The coffee is always good and the baristas are friendly. I always get the creme brulee latte with almond milk, it is awesome. They are one of the only places that has almond milk. Most places have soy milk as a milk alternative, which I can't stand the taste of.
Good Korean food in Nashville. The Bi Bim Bop is good and great sauces. Very hospitable staff.

I came with a friend a few weeks ago. There was one other party in the entire restaurant, but they did have a lot of Togo orders. It was frustrating because we ordered miso soup and chicken and rice soup and mine came out good but my friends was like warm and the chicken was not good, very flavorless, not to mention it literally took about 30 minutes for just our soup to come out. While they had time to eat and talk and take care of Togo orders, while we wait waterless and impatient for soup that came out 30 minutes later and not even warm. Then we waiting another 15 for our rolls. They were fresh and we enjoyed them. Just annoying to feel like we weren't taken care of when they easily could have with how slow they were and with the three people that were on. Probably won't eat in again, obviously the Togo orders take priority over the guests in your restaurant.

The only real complaint is that 4 and a highchair don't fit at a 4 top table. My 1 yr old son was on the corner. The bread that they bring out before the meal was delicious, as were the onion rings. The manager noticed that our order was taking a little long, so he brought Mandarin oranges for my son, which was greatly appreciated.  The calamari breading was too heavy, but my burger was good.  The waitress was very pleasant and personable.

Solid gumbo ya ya. Very strong and very good. Service was terrible. This place was expensive for the food and not the service. The waiters seemed to pass us up on occasion at lunch but this could of been because we were not in business suits. When paying  a lot of money for lunch I think it is important that waters be refilled and some attention be payed to the customer. But again, the food was excellent. Just don't expect great/friendly service.
Completely over rated. Small selection of donuts with toppings and they didn't taste that great.

Have enjoyed Jesse's for years. Love their prime rib with mushrooms and their ranch dressing is my favorite. . Usually go for lunch and love their specials.  My husband insists that their burgers are the best he's ever had.

I have been to Fulins 3 times in the past 2 month and enjoy the food.  Each time I have ordered the Crispy Shrimp and Honey Walnuts, however, each time it was presented to my table, it looked different.  The first time I ordered it, it was beautiful and tasted wonderful.  However, the second and third time it was just plain.  Not sure if being "pretty" adds to the flavor, but it does not hurt.

I still like Fulins and plan on returning....maybe I will try something different

Outstanding!  Original, innovative, and unconventional recipes keep your tastebuds on edge never knowing exactly what to expect.  When you dig in you become amazed with the combination of flavors that can leave you in awe that someone could create such a masterpiece.  Getting in is always a problem unless the late afternoon of a weekday.  Their water needs an overhaul with filtration but otherwise a great place for an original experience.
I didn't believe all the hype about southern barbecue until I experienced Edley's. Local spot with a great vibe, fast and friendly service

What an excellent addition to the neighborhood! We started out with the caprese - the fresh mozzarella (made in-house) was perfect. Then we had our focaccia, included for pasta dishes, which was chewy and excellently flavored. The pasta was incredible!! Just perfect, can't wait to try the different sauce options.
The one personal preference I would've changed was the music selection, I would go for something a little more mellow for the vibe of the restaurant. But otherwise, perfect restaurant experience!

I finally made it back for a "regular" visit. The last time I was here was for the Elite dinner and I gave it a 5 star review. Today I was not as satisfied with the service or the food. 

I arrived around 2pm to meet a friend for some lunch. I believe the hostess saw us, but we actually had to ask her for a table. We were not greeted at all. We did have the option to sit on the patio and so we decided to do that; we both love patios! The hostess brought us to a table, placed the menus down, told us about brunch (which runs until 3pm on Sundays), and walked away. I didn't get the sense that she wanted to be there. A few minutes passed by and no one came to our table...then a few more minutes passed and finally a guy showed up to take our drink order; he was not going to be our server though. Our drinks came out and our server showed up. He was friendly once he arrived so things got better. 

We placed our orders ordered some beer and waited for our food. The food arrived in a good amount of time. I was a little disappointed in my meal and I know my friend was as well. I'll start with my order; goat cheese and strawberry salad with grilled chicken. The salad looked like it was drenched in salad dressing. I completely forgot to ask for my dressing on the side and didn't want to send it back. I like dressing so it was ok, but not everyone is like me and that amount of dressing may have been discouraged another customer. The chicken was really tough and dry! For a grilled chicken I was expecting it to me juicy and flavorful; it wasn't. I was disappointed in the overall salad. My friend ordered the steak salad; medium well. When the salad was brought out she too complained about the amount of dressing; maybe we both should have ordered the dressing on the side? Oh, and her steak she said was tough and more like well done. The kitchen missed the ball on this one. I don't think we will recommend the salads in the future. For the prices of the salads I know we were both expecting something better! Each salad was about $15! Whoa! 

Our server did offer bread and was attentive throughout the meal, so he gets some major Kudos! Good job Mike! I just think the kitchen has some work to do. The food has potential if it is done correctly.

absolutely beautiful setup. just being inside the restaurant made me happy even before eating.

definitely a place to go for a drink rather than going to fill up your stomach for a full meal. 

the braised lamb hummus was mmm - so good. i wish the bread that came with it was warmer, though.

meanwhile, the chicken tagine came with bread/naan that had just the right amount of heat and fluffiness! the chicken, rice, and spice that came along were in perfect harmony.

the whitefish salad was a bit disappointing. we were expecting, well, a salad, but we got a spread.

overall, definitely would come again!

Apparently this restaurant has caught a lot of flak for poor service. And good for them, they've read the reviews because we had two attentive servers that were constantly making sure we had everything we needed. A water glass was never less than half empty. The escargot and tomato stack were great. Entrees were good but not something I'd go back for. Overall, nice ambience and good experience. They turn over a lot of tables and do it well. If you're looking for a local intimate dining experience then look elsewhere. But if you are staying in the French quarter and need a good spot that won't disappoint but not dazzle, this is it.
the food isn't bad, but the service is terrible. i've been there several times over the years, and the service has always sucked.

Fresh certainly understands the meaning of the the term Fresh and has successfully embraced and implemented the use of fresh ingredients into all of their menu items. Carefully selecting their fruit for their smoothies, ensuring it is at its peak ripeness and freshness, and working closely with local vendors to bring the best quality into their kitchen, I have no doubt that Fresh will be a top favorite among locals. They may not have the largest menu with complex offerings, but that is exactly what I like about this place. I've had the pleasure of enjoying the Strawberry Chicken Salad, the Chicken Tacos, The Panino with Chicken, roasted Peppers and aioli, and a blissful sip of the smoothie my boyfriend ordered. (p.s. all this food was consumed over 2 visits). Th, the only word that came to mind with every bite was "fresh." It is rare to be wow'd by the intense freshness of ingredients when eating out. The strawberries on the salad were bright red and juicy as can be, the tacos were packed with chipotle flavor yet light, the panino was decadent yet simple, and the smoothie was all tropical, tangy freshness! 

Simple menu + fresh handpicked ingredients + passion = FRESH= perfection

The food is usually good but the service is continually disappointing. Seems like you practically have to chase down the servers for more chips. Today, instead of splitting up the check like we asked our server just put the whole bill for 7 people on one person's card and barely apologized.
The fried rice is a decent deal if you're really hungry. A huge plate for $8. It's a really convenient location so people go here. Typical IV food place. 2 stars say "Meh. I've experienced better."

We were visiting Nashville for just a few days and our friend - a local - brought us to Edley's. Honestly, I can't even remember what BBQ I ordered - all I remember is that mac and cheese. Oh my gosh, that may have been the best mac and cheese I've ever had. I actually went back as we were leaving to order another full side to go, just to get to keep eating it. Casual joint, good service, and the best mac and cheese I've had yet!! Edley's will DEFINITELY be a stop we make again the next time we come to town.

It's Sunday night and the Cards are in the playoffs, we're not cooking or going out for dinner. We didn't want pizza, Chinese or any type of fast food. We were at a a loss for ideas. I was searching Yelp for ideas and checked to see if Joey B's did carry- out and to my surprise they did.  We checked the menu and made the call. 

We ordered two of their Blue Plate Specials; Country Fried Chicken and Homemade Meatloaf. Both came with mashed potatoes and gravy and corn on the cob. The meatloaf also came with a side salad that was humongous, it was big enough for both of us to share. My Homemade Meatloaf  with a brown gravy truly had to down home taste. It is way better then other "Blue Plate Specials" near and on "The Hill". My SO enjoyed his Country Fried Chicken and its white gravy topping. Their great taste surprised us coming from a sports bar which is known for burgers and pizza. 

I think Joey B's will be getting some more carryout orders from us.  They're close, the prices are right and the food is good.

Okay, hear me out. This place surprised me.

My boyfriend's parents wanted to take us to dinner, and picked Red Robin. Being gluten and dairy free, I was kind of worried.
The menu is SUPER allergy friendly! They have dedicated fryers for the fries, and when I asked the server for a gluten free bun, no cheese for my chicken breast sandwich, he read the order back to me at the end to make sure he got it right. And the bun was good.
If you're out and need a safe place to eat, this is definitely worth trying out.

Having grown up with awesome Mexican food in California I'm not a huge fan of tex-mex. We were in the neighborhood and I was craving a sangria so here we were. Great attentive service!! Nice table outside for people watching. Food was ok.

 I wasn't a big fan of my water downed sangria and was sad to see no fruit in the drink. Although at $3.50 a pop (it was 1/2 price sangria day) it worked for me. They had bottles of Negre Modelo (one of my fave beers with Mexican food) which was awesome. 

My husband had the pulled pork enchiladas which were yummy. Not awesome, but definitely good, especially with the beer. I had the chicken salad which was ok. The flavors were overpowered by the onion and I couldn't really get a sense of the chicken salad. Chips were good, salsa was kind of bland. Great addition to the neighborhood and great place to grab a drink (skip the sangria). Ok for food.

I hope this isn't what Philly Cheesesteaks are supposed to be like. It had very dry steak and the cheese whiz had very little flavor. The roll wasn't to bad but again it was what was inside that clearly was a miss for me.

I have to assume that because I am at an airport that this is probably not the best place to go for a traditional cheesesteak here.

Wow, great place to eat... the draft beer  & pretzel, doner bowl  was fantastic... equally important was the server Chrishe...she expertly explained each meal  with enthusiasm!  She does have a passion for service.... We will be back!

Kelly's Kitchen is one of our favorite breakfast spots in the area.  The restaurant is always fairly full, but you can usually always get a table which is appealing especially on a weekend. I love the home fries and eggs benedict.   Although it is something small, I also appreciate that they have french vanilla creamer for the coffee.  The staff is always nice too.  Note that it's cash only!!!

Visited for lunch, it was very busy and I had to get my food to go. Besides not having a table to sit at, friendly service and good food. The wings and fries were hot and fresh. Disappointed in the beast mode sauce, did not taste very spicy to me at all, just a mild burn. Overall good food, will go back in the future.

This place is pigs serving pigs....sushi a mess. Luke warm like the saki. Last time I went some jerk in a tank top and baseball cap sat down next to me and ordered 5 yes 5 items..so guess what there he was AGAIN TODAY.......If eating junk next to families bringing all their kids in to eat off their plates is your thing then THIS IS YOUR PLACE......it is no better than slop and the clientele is gross....sushi chef produces ugly SLOP. AND I AM BEING -----nice------

My co-workers and i love this place.  The burritos are always good and reasonably priced for what you get.  We have them cater events for us and everything is always great and ready on time.  The green salsa is amazing and goes good on everything.  The staff is polite and friendly! This is a hidden gem in tucson!

Rude service. Arrived with friend both of us had coupons ...woman behind counter said only one of us could use because we walked in together we were counted as 1 guest. Tried to ask questions she ignores us talking and clowning around with co workers. Very rude to us and people behind us. Then to round it off slide bolt breaking in bathroom locked in for 5 minutes before I could get it unlocked. No thank you.

We came here for Downtown Dining Week and were definitely not disappointed! I started off with a drink that was made special for that day - the Skinny Bellini, made with champagne, peach juice, and lychee juice. I could literally drink it all day. The bread and small appetizers in serving spoons came out next. The bread was freshly made and super soft and tasty. I really liked how the servers describe what's in your food when they bring it to you. I had these garlic prawns that made me crave more. The entire menu for dining week looked great! There were so many options but I had to go with the steak and lobster. Really, who can turn down a good surf and turf? Maybe my vegetarian friend but she loved the Three Mushroom Ravioli. The steak was done medium rare, just the way I like it, and the lobster came with a sauce that was served in the shell under the lobster meat which I thought was very creative. And of course, for dessert, I went with the Sticky Toffee Pudding that comes with a scoop of ice cream on top. What's different about it was that there was popcorn in the pan it was served in. If you like caramel popcorn, you need to try this dessert. I also tried the Panna Cotta and it's great if you like a lighter, less sweet dessert but really, the portion and taste of the toffee pudding ended the meal on a high note. I highly recommend this place!  By the way, the menu on their website is outdated so some of the more gamey meats are no longer available.

Home away from home. Service is always great, whether I'm there with one or two other people or manage to drum up a whole party. The bartenders and servers always add that extra step (such as placing a kitchen order 5 minutes before the kitchen closes) that makes it feel like I'm not just some other customer they're trying to gleam a couple dollars in tips from.

For bar food, nachos are where it's at. They're a great price for a huge pile of molten cheese, salsa and sour cream. I was skeptical about a burger being served on an English muffin, but it actually came out as something pretty unique and quite tasty. I work nights, but I've been meaning for a long time to come in and actually sit down for dinner.

Don't roll in expecting a sports bar when you see their big flat screens on the walls. Don't expect the same kind of service you'd get at a TGIF either. The drinks, food and service are always worth it.

I'm not really sure what the hours are for this place.   They are open at random times.  Something tells me that this is a front for some money laundering scheme.  The burritos are huge, but the ingredients do not taste fresh.

This Moe's is disgusting! I have been to the Moe's in Deptford many times and have always had a pleasant experience. This was my first and ONLY time at the sicklerville location and it was appalling. FIRST I ordered the close talker and the lettuce was basically all orange and rusty. Mainly all of the ingredients did not taste fresh, far from actually. Then as I'm getting my drink the floor was ridiculously sticky! My shoes were sticky the rest of the day. It was disgusting. The floors were gross, the tables were gross, everything was gross. I love Moe's but I will never return to this location!

Delicious! It's BYOB, like many places in Phoenixville. Most of their dishes are spicy, so it's best to avoid if you don't like spice. Their curry was delicious, though. A big unexpected to find a Thai Place in Phoenixville, but I was happy nonetheless!

Everything about this place was amazing. From the atmosphere, to the wine, to each course. Every time the waiter brought something to our "table" (large gold platter) we said "this is my favorite!" Make sure you pace yourself and save room for baklava and mint tea at the end.

The service was amazing!!! I got their wings and milkshake and it was out of this world!! My husband got a burger and he said it was awesome !! I shouldn't get enough of their fries and sauces!! Great food
First time trying here after raving reviews from friends. Delicious food, amazing banana pudding and friendly service! Can't wait till next time.
The burgers are awesome. A bit pricey but great service. The happy hour 4-6 the prices are just right. Great patio area.

When I found this place on Buzzfeed, I was excited to try it since its close to where I live. Upon  arriving it was packed due to a charity thing with a local sorority. My friend and I were ok waiting for the line. Everyone seemed so friendly, but I quickly learned it was just a facade. I ordered two pizzas as  I was pretty hungry. A margarita and a custom. My custom pizza was to die for. I could eat it again and again. The margarita was not quite up to par. I asked for extra basil and got maybe 4-5 leafs. It had zero flavor and was pretty disappointing. I felt as if they rushed me through the line. I told one guy about the "finishing touches" and then the girl who was to do it, ignored him and didn't do it.. Mind you this was after she took her extra long hair out of her pony tail re fixed her hair and put it back up all while on the line. As a chef, I was disgusted, but didn't want to be rude as I felt i was too far into the process to turn back now. The employees seemed pretty happy but almost robot like. Not wanting to laugh or joke back. When I asked a question they seemed annoyed to answer. I brought wine as they told me they were BYOB. ALL of the wine glasses were pretty nasty and gross. I had to rewash mine when I got outside to my seat. My girlfriend and I enjoyed our meal outside. She went in to get me a box and  I put the leftovers of my two pizzas on one platter while I waited. An employee came out to throw out the trash. He made slight friendly conversation and promptly asked me to hold my pizza while i waited because he wanted to take my board inside now instead of coming back out for it. It was 6pm. The night wasn't even close to being over. And I would have been happy to return it. I found it completely rude that I had to hold my greasy, hot pizza while  I waited for my friend to bring me a box because the gentleman didn't want to come back later to clean up the board. It rubbed me the wrong way. 
The layout of the place was a bit over congested. Trying to go back to the bathroom, you had to fight your way through the customers who were waiting to be waited on to get there. And college kids are not the friendliest. 
Overall Im giving 3 stars because of the staff and the lack of flavor in such a simple pizza. I don't think I will be going out of my way again to visit the place.

Aldine's staff seems very nice and they were really friendly. BUT-their food is overpriced and hyped up. My friends and I went to celebrate her birthday, and I guess we should have known that from the pictures the portions are so small!!! I guess that's why you have to order multiple dishes. We ordered the onion plate and pork belly with squid to first try out some plates because their menu isn't your typical menu. The onion salad filled only the halt of the plate and we were confused to what were eating. The pork belly lacked flavor and the rice crackers and squid did not complement the pork belly. I may have high standards for pork belly since I eat it regularly at home or with friends. My friends and I quickly left after trying the food. We went to Continental afterwards which is a block away.
Staff is unorganized.  Rooms are mediocre.  Prices in the hotel in general are marked up and the elevators sound like the are on their last leg.  Many other options in the area to enjoy.
Service was a little slow because the place is a little small, but the food was great. Don't expect to get a table right away even on a weekday.

We found this place on Yelp and went for dinner one evening. We ordered crab rangoon, drunken noodles, hawaiian fried rice and panang curry. Food came pretty fast and was just okay. The staff was quite friendly and responsive. I think I would do take out next time, but not worthy of dine-in.

I'm still thinking about the bread pudding.   I've been craving bread pudding since eating the one here.  What I liked the most is that they didn't put raisins in it.    The roasted chicken was friggin delicious also !   We also ate at August but I think I prefer Luke.   Not that one was better than the other, I just like the casual atmosphere of Luke because we didn't have any formal clothes and we were dining with kids.   Oh yeah, the french fries were really good also.  I also like the location of being in the CBD and away from all the chaos in the French Quarter.

We visited this establishment last Sunday, and it was very busy.  We had a large party (4 adults - 4 children), and they were able to accommodate our party within a reasonable time - we didn't wait more than 20 minutes for a table.  Pretty good start.

The hostess was friendly, and smiled, and let us know that the wait wasn't horrible, and offered us menus to look at while we waited.  The rest of the staff seemed friendly, and it appeared managers were table touching to make sure the guest experience was good.

It's from here that things started to go downhill.  First off, the seating in the dining room is VERY cramped, at least where we were led.  The tables were close together, and the place was stuffed with people.  It was difficult to move our party to the seats, and even more difficult to use the facilities and eventually leave - especially with a car seat and three little ones in tow.  If you have small children, car seats, wheelchairs, etc. - ask to sit in the area where you enter; the most space to move about is there.

The food came out slow - almost an hour.  The hash browns were cold.  The bacon was limp, with one near-raw - and we had specifically asked for crisp bacon when we ordered.  We were missing a glass of milk.  We were short silverware, napkins, and syrup.  We had three orders of pancakes on the table with no syrup.  Odd, for a pancake house.

My wife and I each had eggs benedict - very average.  One of the poached eggs was overcooked, and the other was under cooked.  I tried a little of everything on the table - from omelets to biscuits and gravy to pancakes - and it was all very, very average.  I was excited and happy to see another breakfast spot pop up close to the house, but we won't be returning.  For our money, we'll go somewhere else or simply eat at home.

This place is a hidden secret.  The wings in my opinion are better than wing stop and they have more flavors.  The lemon pepper is flavorful and the 5 pepper is very good if you like the pepper taste.  I lot of yelper may comment that the the shack is not in the best of areas but what great restaurant is???  Dookie Chase and Willie Maes are only about 6 blocks from here.  I do recommend being safe in any area you go to in New Orleans after dark but as long as you are careful you should be okay.  Oh and before I forget the Ghetto Punch is a must.  I know the secret to it because my grandmother used to make it all the time but Im not telling. Enjoy

I just want to start by saying that I used to love this pizza place, so it's not like I'm crazy. 

I ordered over the phone for a delivery. The lady who I spoke with took 15 minutes to make an order of 1 pizza and a pepsi. I felt like she was falling asleep while we were on the phone and I had to repeat myself like 4 times. 

She gave the wrong address to the delivery guy, he told my husband that it was a miracle he was actually in the right place. So, good job delivery guy :)! 

The pizza.... For some reason... It looked and tasted OLD. I have nothing against frozen pizza, I've never had one, but it looked and tasted like I would imagine a frozen pizza looks and tastes. 

I don't know what happened, really. We were looking forward all week to get pizza from this place but ended up being a disappointment.

A couple of friends and I met here for brunch on a Sunday morning. It was completely lackluster. My eggs with lox and capers was okay and the hash browns were greasy. My friend ordered the French toast with berries; the berries turned out to be jam. The only real positive is that we were seated quickly. With so many great places in the city to go for brunch, I don't think I'll be coming back.

This place has an amazing view of the gulf and the bay as it rotates. I think the food is pretty good especially for lunch. I only came once for dinner and thought it was overpriced for the food. Lunch is very reasonable at around $10 per person. If you haven't been here before, go for lunch and you won't be disappointed

We tried this for the first time tonight. We decided to go early to try and beat the dinner crowd and unfortunately they were already busy and we had to sit in the front patio area. It would have been nice to see the entire restaurant. Fortunately the server was great and really knew the menu and actually assisted us with our selections. We started with the deviled crab appetizer. It was a small portion but was really tasty.....make sure you use the lime. I had the salmon and it was fantastic. My husband had the shrimp and grits and he said it was just a little bit spicy and tasted great. We look forward to returning to try some the other menu items.

When this place opened last fall, I was really psyched about it, it being right around the corner from Uarts. I quickly became addicted.  I wanted to stay true to Jean's, but I couldn't stop myself because of the  huge variety of vegetarian/vegan options. Also the organic and Asian items in the back of the store I often splurge on.

The veggie chicken hoagie is my usual, but sometimes I switch it up and get the veggie grilled chicken fajitas, or the 'create-your-own- panini thing, which has a so many choices. 

I also love Sylvia the morning/afternoon woman at the register. She is always very sweet.

This has got to be one of the worst Mexican experiences that we've ever had. It was 4:30 pm and we had just flown back into town. Decided to try the place because we see it all the time when we eat at Carrabas. We walk in and see one employee sitting at the bar --reading a paperback. He looks up and says, "Oh, just sit anywhere. ". We sat ourselves and menus were brought to us. About 10 minutes later, he got up and asked if we wanted to order. By this time, we really didn't, but were already invested in the bad experience, that we went ahead and ordered. The food took forever  and was horrible. The sauce tasted like someone opened a can of Hunts tomato sauce and poured it on the enchiladas. There were no refills of drinks, and I had to go get him (still reading his novel) when it was time for us to pay. I thought, "What a slug". Horrible service, horrible food, and horrible experience. The place was so mismanaged -- rest room was filthy, from training of employees to quality of food. It has the air of a place on its way out, rather than on its way to the top. I recommend that you avoid this place.

My go-to place for authentic Vietnamese food! Usually I eat in but this time I got carry out. I've been craving for some Banh mi so I ordered BBQ Banh mi. I love this toasted Vietnamese sandwich. It's full of flavor and they don't skimp on the meat either. When eating in I usually get the Special pho with all the tendons, tripe, flank meat, and meatball. The broth is perfect and requires little seasoning. The Spring Rolls with the peanut hoisin sauce is a great appetizer to start with. 


While the food is good and cheap the service is another thing. Expect to be greeted and waited on with an attitude. Also expect to pay with cash only. No cards!

I've visited this location several times and each time I return, I ask myself "why"? This particular location is the most inconsistent in service, appearance and quality. As a franchised restaurant, management, HQ and employees need to pay attention.  Customer service: greet your customer with friendliness. Say "please and thank you" Those words go a long way. If it's an inconvenience to tend to customers, you're in the the wrong line of work.  The line staff need to work together to make production consistent,  efficient and accurate. Appearance: OMG! Wipe down the tables! Designate an employee to monitor the dining area. Keep tables clear, pick up or sweep crumbs from the floor. This visit I witnessed an employee walk past and over 2 napkins that were on the floor. If the dining area looks like crap, what does the food prep area look like? Food: I've had lukewarm burrito bowls & cold tacos.....pay attention!!!

I've given this location so many chances....MAYBE if the franchisee noticed slow sales numbers they'd reconsider who to put in place in management of their investment.

The location of the place was a little hard to find since we were dining for the first time. Arriving there, the staff was friendly and inviting. We made a note on the reservation that there was a birthday and we were seated in a window booth with an outstanding view of the city and sunset. Our server was very informing, courteous, and made our first experience delightful. It is a higher end restaurant so be prepared to spend some cash, but it is perfect for special occasion.

Wait staff was polite, pleasant and efficient.  Food was OK, not great.  Clam chowder like a can of Progresso.  

Ambiance was zero, but could still be OK; like a crab house on theMaryland shore that specializes in their food, not the environment.

Went there to check out a place to take guests after a tour of the Historical sights, but this is not the place.

Worst thing was the mismatch of the prices with the overall experience.  For those prices I would have expected waiters in tuxes with linen napkins over their arms.

The beer selection is amazing and the servers know their beer so if you have a tough time deciding, they can help you out.  I have been here twice and both times I ordered the peanut butter and jelly burger.  When I go again I will order it a third time.  It is just that good.  It is the perfect combination of sweet and salty.  They offer sweet potato fries which have a light coating of sugar on them.  They are just ok.  I will probably try a different side next time.  The only reason this place didn't get five stars is that the decor is pretty meh.  They have a lot of room for improvement.  However when looking at just the food and drinks, this place is a must go!!

I normally give positive reviews on yelp because I think there is too much negativity in this world. However, I have not been to a McDonald's where the employees were more unpleasant, indifferent, or downright rude. Food is normal McDonald's fare, but be prepared for employees who obviously don't care about their job.

Once again I have received some of the best service I've ever got at a chilis before. Our waitress Katrina(like the hurricane) was absolutely fantastic, nice, polite, got everything right and kept our drinks full the entire time! 5 stars again chills keep it up.
Everything about this place is amazing!!! The food and dessert are delicious. Everything is so reasonably priced! Our waitor, Joe was amazing, hilarious and helpful!

Our first visit and we were disappointed (mostly).  I'm Italian so I look for good Italian markets and got super excited.  I admit, it is an experience, going from room to room, section to section selecting goodies.  I'll go from best to worst 'cause we bought a lot.  The cheese we bought, while the selection was not plentiful, was VERY good/enjoyable, albeit pricey.  The fresh-made pizza tasted really good but the crust is just too thick and hard to chew (and they don't put cooking instructions on the pizza which they should).  Bought the marinara sauce; I make better so I won't do that again, it was too sweet like school cafeteria sauce.  Bought my fave Italian pastries Sfogliatella (the clam shaped multi layer pastry) and Cannolis.  The Sfogliatella was passable but nothing like what it should be.  The Cannolis were just awful and a huge disappointment -- absolutely not even close to authentic; the cream was too thick, the shell not fresh, just didn't taste right at all; have never thrown a cannoli out.  Bought the pre-made large eggplant parm.  We were disappointed maybe because of the sauce, I don't know but I can't recommend it.  Now my sister and brother-in-law go all the time and purposely for the eggplant parm so...you decide.  We have found more authentic Italian markets around Florida in Fort Myers (Marios) and Miami and Cape Coral with great authentic sauces, etc.  If you want the best of the best, then get your Italian pastry in New York City at Veneiro's and get your Italian goodies at Eataly in Chelsea.  Sorry, we are spoiled ex-New Yorkers so hard to please us.  Mazzaro's is ok for the experience and a one-time visit but won't be a staple for us.
Great Vesper Martini, okay gumbo, kinda cool atmosphere. I probably won't go back but it was a good place to stop in.

I do not understood how this place has 4 stars. Service was good. However, the food really disappointed me. The guacamole was very bland. The rice and beans where the worst I have ever had. Everything else was just ok.

I've ordered from uber eats with them before and had great service.  Today I ordered and they delivered 2 of my orders incorrectly with brown rice instead of white. If I'm going to be paying more for this delivery order through uber eats I expect for them to get it right.  Instead of acknowledging that they got it wrong,  the rep insisted she was right, did not offer a refund or a replacement and called me a bitch upon hanging up.  I have Never had such bad service.  Never returning again.

The new remodel Gator Dockside looks a lot better than the old one. They have change the carpet floor to wood floor look more elegant. From the old projected TV to digital large screen TV. The renovation is welcoming the patron to the new football season. 

I like to come to this restaurant mainly is their chicken wings. First, select the way you want it - Grill, breaded, wet sauce, or boneless. Second, select number of wings. Third, select the flavor. Tonight we have tried 12 different flavors. My top three I like most are grill chipotle BBQ, grill Thai chili, and the grill Yucatan. If you dare, try their 4 alam wings. This wing is super hot that one of our friends tries it and burn the mouth. I also like the peanut butter flavor with unique taste. 

This sport bar is family oriented bar. Many families bring their kids. They have the children menu. The restaurant service is good and the food came out fast with 100 wings.

Just had a wonderful dinner with family and friends at Punky's. Steven was an excellent waiter and took great care of us. I had the Cajun chicken with brie cheese sauce, fresh vegetables, and jalapeño macaroni and cheese. Delicious!
