Only the best southern comfort brunch food you can find. I'm so lucky to live just a few blocks away. The eggs dauphine is nothing short of amazing. Laid back service from locals who make you feel right at home. Plus they carry French Truck coffee. Definitely give this a place a try for brunch!

This café certainly is cozy. Great ambiance! Perfect for a quick pastry or have coffee with friends. You can choose to sit at a table, at the bar or in the nice couches area. 

They offer a great selection of coffee. I had a latté and it was delicious. However I went there at 9am and had to realize on the spot that this is not a breakfast café. They do offer a choice of 2 breakfast sandwiches but it was very disappointing: small, tasteless and soggy. Makes me wonder why they bother serving that. It gives the wrong idea of their potential. 

Still I really enjoy the place and will definitely come back and try more.
This was some of the best steak that I have ever had.  The margaritas were very good.  We had the corn side, and

The atmosphere was charming and relaxed. Service by Eliz was incredible; she was attentive, accommodating and quick to serve. She gave us updates and was fully knowledgeable about the dishes. The flavors were savory, balanced and well-developed. The portions were so filling, we took home doggie bags.

When Garcia's first opened the food and service were excellent. Both dropped to average for some time. However, both are back.  Those of you looking for a  great dining experience  should give it a try.
Good quality Chinese food.  Friendly service and a full bar too.   We love bringing our 2 boys ages 3 and 1 for a reasonably priced night out.  Definitely would recommend.

This place is pretty good - tasty chicken in a bar like atmosphere.  My boyfriend and I shared a 4-piece order of fried chicken, all white ($4 upgrade), with mashed potatoes and coleslaw.  The chicken was perfectly crispy and fresh from the fryer.  It lacked a bit of seasoning, but the addition of honey and hot sauce did the trick.  

Despite some other reviews, I actually thought the prices were very fair.  The two of us shared an order of 4-pieces of fried chicken breasts which came with a good serving of potatoes, a small serving of coleslaw, and two fluffy rolls with honey butter.  For $14 we had dinner for 2 and leftovers.

The place was pretty full, as it was a friday night.  There were plenty of tables open but we were pleasantly surprised at the large and relatively young and lively crowd.  

Overall, a good meal for a decent price at a fun place.  If you enjoy the bar scene, this is a great place to sit, drink, relax, and eat some serious fried chicken.

This newest addition to Reno's galaxy of Mexican cuisine opened just as 2013 was making its last bows, and I think they're off to a pretty good start. I've watched this space during its remodel over the past year, and for a while wondered whether Bistro Habanero was coming or going. I actually had to create this Yelp page in order to write a review ... it's that new!

As it happened, I was putting gas in my truck (it's next-door to a gas station I frequent) and noticed the lighted OPEN sign in the window. Even though I wasn't really hungry, I wanted to check the place out and purchase a nibble to take home. Although there is plenty of Mexican fare on the menu, they also have some Salvadoran cuisine. I ordered two of the most common Salvadoran favorites, pupusa rebuelta and pupusa queso y loroco, and hurried home to share them with my wife.

In a word, OUTSTANDING! In particular, I really enjoyed the pupusa rebuelta and will definitely be back for more. The service was very friendly, the place is clean & nicely decorated, and in general was a far cry from what I had expected during their lengthy build-out. 

On a repeat visit I tried the ceviche tostada special and a stacked quesadilla. The ceviche gave me pause because it's the first time I can recall having this item with refried beans in the mix. However, I was pleasantly surprised by how well these flavors combined, and the half-moon fried tortilla was light and crispy underneath all the fish, veggies, and sauce. The stacked quesadilla (meat & veggies & cheese, oh my!) was totally tasty, and my wife enjoyed the mix of tacos she ordered. Everything tasted very fresh, including the tortilla chips.

P.S. they're open for breakfast Mon-Sat at 6:30am (10am Sun). Might have to make a detour on my way to work!
Overrated and very expensive for what you get. I am all for supporting local but this was by far one of the worst breakfasts I have ever had.
We order from here on Saturdays for all of the sales staff at our dealership.  It is AWESOME!!! Never had a bad meal from here.
Excellent pizza, hoagies, grinders, and cheesesteaks (5 stars for their Buffalo Chicken Cheesesteak).  Eat in, take out or delivery - it's all good!
They must have thought it was my first time!? Salmon smelled horrible and was sweating... After losing my appetite I sent the food back, paid for my beer and left!

After walking around last night we decided to stop in and have a late meal. 

First thing that stood out was the friendly and attentive service. I wish I could remember the young lady's name but she was great. 

The beer was ice cold which hit the spot on the a hot night in New Orleans. 

Gumbo and shrimp poboy were very good. 

Not really a fan of the deserts but other than that will definitely be back.

got to check them out during mt airy night market in august. long line but worth the wait. got the fish with greens and mac. loved it. douse the fish with lots of hot sauce and your set. for what you pay you get a lot. more than 4 pieces of fish. the collard greens hit the spot and mac and cheese was great. this was satisfying meal. makes you sleep after ;)

I checked out this food truck on my lunch break. I ordered a steak burrito and it was great. I did however ask for no onion but unfortunately they were in it, minus a star for that. Everything is cooked to order so it took about 15 minutes or so for them to make it. I would probably call ahead if you are on lunch break or in a rush.  Decent pricing, worth checking out.
I've been here a few times and really enjoy their food. They were also one of the only places open during the Snowpocalypse (aka Snow Storm Jonas) so I really appreciated that.
One of my favorite places thus far. Traveled all the way from CT and can't wait to come back for noodles. Everyone was so friendly. Gluten free options as well as vegan!

Been twice and I have no complaints. Food is always great, especially the Tavern Burger and great beer on tap. This place will not disappoint. The service is even better. Great music box too with all the updated music. If you go ask for Aubree!!!!!!
After going to Raijin for a while now its its legitimately one of my favorite places in town. Ive troed every kind of ramen and their bowls. Everything is tasty and the ramen is filling.

Hated it. 
Messy, overpriced, noisy, obnoxious chain. 
I could kick myself for agreeing to come here. 
I couldn't find a damn thing to eat either. 
Meh.
Yes and yes. Great breakfast, brunch or lunch stop on the corner of Keswick and Easton! Good food, vintage-y atmosphere. We've been eating here since they opened.

I love this place, especially their crab wontons, lettuce wraps, Ginger Salmon and Mongolian Chicken, Beef, or Shrimp. I love the atmosphere too. Even though it's a chain, it's one of my favorite places to eat.

My fiance hosted his son's rehearsal dinner here in December.  The service was great and the food was delicious!  I had some kind of pasta in lemon sauce (ordered without the chicken) that we all agreed was wonderful, and everyone else seemed happy with their food as well (there were a lot of Chicken Parm and various other dishes that people were ohhing and ahhing over.)  If I lived in the area, I'd be going back!

Christmas Eve was the first time I've ever been in Hon's. It was the only place I could find that was opened after 6 PM and I had a guest.  We were so hungry that we ordered almost everything on the picture board! LOL! I ordered hot braised chicken, green beans (those are always great in any Chinese restaurant), chicken kebabs, bok choy, lo mien with shrimp, ham and pork and crab rangoon.  Some of my hot braised chicken was so hard that it was like eating rocks, and the bok choy needed to be cut into smaller pieces, but the green beans were outstanding, the crab rangoon was pretty good and for the price, it was the best for what you got! I didn't like the rice. It had an over cooked slightly burned flavor, but the rice wasn't needed and, personally, I didn't like the chicken kebabs. Overall I say, great for the price. There is an AUTHENTIC CHINESE menu in the middle of the written board and the written board has a bout a thousand items to chose from?! The phone kept ringing off the hook and the woman who took my order was extremely pleasant. I'd go there again, very pleased. Accept credit card payments.

I know Pho. I eat and frequent most pho restaurants in this city. With the recent explosion of pho restaurants uptown and on this side of the river I have had a hard time finding a place that serves Tendon. I think because most places are designed to serve white people or non Asians. This place has Tendon and a damn good broth. In my opinion the best pho on this side if you know what I mean. Super excited about getting my Tendon fix so close to home. Thanks

Found this place on yelp because of its existing reviews and went with my family while we were down here on vacation.

Everything we ordered was "Manhattan-quality-meets-hometown" fare. From the appetizers to the shared plates to the main courses... everything was exceptional; exceeding our wildest expectations.

If you go there and only order one thing make sure it is the Brie appetizer with the Brandy/Brown Sugar infusion and currents. Mind blowing.

No wait. No crowds. Reasonably fast service. Extremely friendly waitstaff. 

Just go.

Muriel's deserves a 5-stars for several reason:
1. Excellent food
2. Immaculate service
3. It saves my impression of hyped up over priced restaurants in the French Quarter.

After the sub-par experience at Brennan's Restaurant on Royal St. it's a relief that service is still not forgotten in a true 5 stars venues.  People come to places like this expecting a certain standard and Muriel's met every single one of them.

Friendly, attentive wait staff. Prompt service. Warm bread and fresh coffee. Great food and great music. 

I'm not going to be lengthy because I want you to go there and experience it yourself. 

All around great experience with solid 5 stars.

So, me and my best friend have been going to almost every coffee shop in Nashville looking for our favorite and this is definitely a top contender! Really cool atmosphere with a lot of seating (which is rare for some cafés) great for studying or meeting up with friends. The coffee is amazing and the baristas are awesome! Would recommend for any coffee or tea lover.

Good sushi. Everything tasted fresh! The fried rice and seaweed salad were delicious too. Service was great. We went on a Monday night around 7:30 and there were only a few other people eating. Very reasonable prices too! Couldn't believe the glasses of wine were only $4! I will definitely be returning or getting take out from here sometime soon.

We had 9pm fri reservations for 14 ladies for a bachelorette dinner. We were seated promptly but at 2 separate tables next to each other. The place was pretty roomy and lovely. The bar area was separated from the main dining which was great. The bathrooms were clean. Service was great. I ordered a refreshing martini, crawfish & goat cheese crepe, and escargot Orleans. I tasted some friends desserts the bread pudding and creme brûlée. Everything was delicious. The waitress was sweet and recommended us a great place to go dancing afterwards. Price was reasonable. I recommend this place totally!

Was pretty excited to check out a new Korean place! Especially one mostly dedicated to fried chicken (and some random things). 

The chicken itself comes in two flavours: crispy deep fried with breading, and sweet & hot sauce. A bonus is that every order is lovingly deep fried into oblivion in seven minutes. So you're not getting some old "re-fried" leftovers (like McDonalds and their hash browns) and your chicken's going to be burning hot. YEAH!

Unfortunately, this is where I felt a bit let down...  the crispy version didn't that much taste to it. I guess it's so you can taste the chicken itself, but it was just wasn't particularly exciting, you know? I loved the texture of the breading though...mmm. 

Meanwhile, the hot & spicy chicken has a very strong hot pepper paste taste. I like cooking Korean food and love using hot pepper paste, but I don't like it when the whole thing tastes like nothing but hot pepper paste. The sauce just had too much of it and I couldn't taste anything else. 

This place could be kinda pricey at $22.99 for 10 pieces, as you only get one side to go with that, daikon or fries (nothing special). The chicken is supposed to be 100% hormone free and all that niceness, though, so that could also account for the higher price.  Lots of people do take-out but if you sit in, you can also ask for some tea. The restaurant's very spacious and clean. I also saw a lunch special for $7. 

Overall, I'm still looking for a good Korean Fried Chicken joint in Edmonton I can keep going back to, but I'll probably have to continue satisfying my cravings elsewhere (for now!).

I went to Pagoda Noodle Cafe with four other women after a great time at the July concert and fireworks on Penn's Landing.  When we walked in we were asked, "How many?" I said: "Five."  As we were being led to our tables, one of the women with us asked if we could sit at a round table that we just walked past.  They obliged.  I wasn't feeling well, so I asked the gentleman seating us for Chinese tea.  He said ok and left.

Then another person came to serve us.  She asked if we were ready to order.  I sensed an attitude from her right away.  Nonetheless, I place my order, which was for Chinese tea, as that's all I was planning to have.

The other women with me were still looking at the menus, but went ahead and placed their drink orders.  The server then appeared agitated.  As she was walking away to get our drinks, I asked if there was a problem (remember, I'm not feeling well, so I'm not putting a lot of energy or neck movements into my question).  She said, "I asked if y'all were ready!"  You see, she wanted to take our *entree* orders, not our drink orders.  That's what she meant by "ready."  When we only gave her our drink orders, it frustrated her and she let us know with her poor attitude. 

Now, I can take attitude from anyone, but any restaurant has a choice to make:  They can either give me attitude or take my money.  But not both, and not at the same time.

So we left.

This is an absolutely great place for all-you-can-eat Sushi. The menu is perfect for first timers or those who do not know much about sushi. They have photos of every item so it truly helps making the decisions easier. The service is great and it's a good atmosphere to go into. The options are more limited than other sushi places. However, the food itself is delicious and truly recommended.

Wow really.. Stop pushing me.. I'm still eating don't ask if it's cash or credit.. 
Soup was great my app was cold but otherwise ok.. I don't like pushy servers.. I like to eat in peace.. Go away
Jalepeno margaritas. Grilled artichokes. Mac and cheese. Amazing.

I really like to support local businesses as much as possible. My Wife and I had been wanting to try this place for 2 years despite some of the reviews we had heard. It's true that the "atmosphere", decor etc are quite uninspiring. It doesn't really give you the impression of a place where you are buying a $55-65 Steak meal. I love the idea and the concept of supporting local farmers. I think that the ambiance and overall presentation is very lacking and uninspired, unlike their phenomenal concept. I think they should highlight and mention their local partnerships with where they source their goods. Although I did enjoy the twice baked potatoes, The fries were ok and the charcuterie board was ok (it was quite large), the best part was the truffle chips that came with the Charcuterie board. The helping was great and the bacon jam good I found the lack of more cheese styles disappointing. One of the cheeses my wife and I didn't even touch. Had we know more of the description of what it came with we may have changed our order.  I imagine there are many other items on the menu that are exceptional. It seems the Duck is one of the hits, perhaps had we chosen differently from the menu we would have been more pleased. However, a 14 oz Rib eye was overcooked and at $60 or as the menu states "market price" I was curious to find out more about what market they were talking about. 

Overall, I wish the business well. I think a few updates to the decor, shifting from paper menus and some more engaging music may boost its ambiance and people will feel more appropriate about the pricing to reflect the overall feel of the establishment. The food was good, it just wasn't incredible, amazing or exceptional. I think we would have enjoyed our time at the Keg or sawmill more. 

Service was good. Our server was a very nice and informed young lady. Thanks for that!

My mother-in-laws favorite coffee shop in New Orleans so we had to stop by! Very impressed. I got an Italian soda with lavender + vanilla (yum!) with a splash of cream and a cold brew coffee on tap. Both were delicious! My husband got a medium roast with 2 shots of espresso (his favorite) and we both were very happy with both the service and the quality of their drinks! Everyone is super friendly and talkative which is a perk to me because when I try new places I hate to be rushed or pressured. They let me taste the cold brew and explained the different flavors in their brewed roasts. We loved it and we stopped by before we hit the road back to Dallas. Thanks Envie we will be back!

Literally just got back from dinner at Fat Ham. Not only is the food undoubtedly one of the best I've had in Philly, but the service is impeccable. It turned out that the restaurant had done something wrong with my reservation, so my dining companion and I had to sit at a small, high table near the bar area. It really was no biggie, but Ben (the manager) insisted on sending over a few dishes on the house - incredibly generous! In addition to the 4 that we ordered, we had about 5 others, all of which were delicious. Some standouts were: the hot chicken (crunchy, juicy, extra spicy) with the white bread and creamy ranch dressing; the shrimp and grits (not too heavy and the shrimp tasted fresh and meaty); the baked mac and cheese (flavorful and crunchy from the barbecue potato chips, sprinkled over the top); and tender pulled pork on white bread and thinly sliced pickles. Really though - you can't go wrong with anything on the menu. 

I'm sure I would've enjoyed the meal, even without those extra dishes, but what made it better was the hospitality and service of the entire staff.  The dining area itself is small as the other reviews say, but it has this warmth and coziness that doesn't make it feel cramped at all. I'll definitely be back, and can't wait to try Sbraga soon.

WE stopped in for a quick lunch today. we had not been in a long time. Gyro plate was mediocre at best. I was very disappointed. There are too many good restaurants in Nashville  so I wont be back. Meat was bland. Pita had no taste.

First thing that surprised me was the place was actually quite large and spacious. When I see the word "cafe", I usually think of a small sandwich shop (with a starbucks type feel to it). This was not the case here. Plenty of room to stretch out and relax.

Wait staff was friendly and able to make recommendations.

We got the slam burger (bacon, avocado, onions, pepper jack cheese) and mels chicken cutlet (fried chicken sandwich). The burger was cooked perfect (medium like I ordered) and my wife said she would rank the chicken a solid 7 out of 10.

Perfect "hole-in-the wall" Mexican. 

All your favorites. Tacos, tostadas, sopas, etc. Extensive menu. Great service. Very clean, and festively decorated restaurant. 

My one minor complaint would be the beans and rice were just... Well, beans and rice. But everything else was outstanding!

Oh -- and dinner for two came to a whopping $19.22.

Had a great time at Momo's!  We made a reservation for Friday evening in case they were busy.  There was a belly dancer for part of our meal, which was super fun and kept the atmosphere alive.  We ordered the roasted red pepper hummus which was delicious.   We also order the lamb gyro....HUGE!  There is so much to this that you can't even pick it up to eat it.  Very delicious!  The restaurant was kind of musty and warm though.  Could have been that it was starting to rain and they had people coming in/out from the outside patio.  Had a great time overall!

Used to drive out of my way to come to this location, (I live closer to the one down 4th st)
A few times we have ordered our regular steak bowl, they barely put any meat or rice. I felt like I wasn't given what I payed for, regardless of they are busy or not . I won't be coming back due to it being an on going issue. They also never have tea or lemons!

We came for the lunch buffet. It was around $10. There was a good selection of tasty dishes, and even 4 choices of dessert. It felt like one of the best Indian buffets I recall, and I've been to a lot. It was a pleasant surprise to see they had samosas in the buffet.
Sushi Nara is awesome- always fresh, well prepared, and delicious! We love the spicy ramen, and you can't beat the prices for good sushi in Tucson. This is an eastside gem!

My mum had been looking forward to eating at Village Inn, as this was one of those places she would visit with my step dad, who passed away three months ago.

We decided to visit our local Village Inn on Carrollwood, and I have to say this was the first and last time for me at this restaurant. 

After we were seated, we were stuck with possibly the rudest waitress I've ever encountered in Tampa Bay. She couldn't wait for us to decide on what we were going to eat, so she left us, then returned still with the worst attitude ever.

The food was horrendous. I ordered the 1/2 lb. Chicken-Fried Steak & Eggs withsunny side up eggs, which arrived cold, and hash browns which tasted nothing like hash browns but entirely like old cooking oil. I did inform the waitress about the eggs, and though she immediately tried to make amends, I must say that I passed on them preparing two more eggs to replace the ones on my plate. After having tasted the undercooked and cold eggs, my stomach couldn't really put itself through that again.

My son ordered a tuna melt with fries, which smelled very fishy, almost as if the tuna had gone bad. 

My mother ordered a strawberry crepes with home fries, and a fruit salad, which were good. And my youngest ate the French Toast from the Kids' Menu, with bananas, which was a nice portion for a three year old. 

I had to ask our waitress to bring out the syrup that goes with the Kid's French toast because she didn't think about it.

Even though the manager was nice enough to come to our table to apologize for badly cooked eggs,  and tried to give us a free slice of pie, we'll not be returning to the Village Inn.

The first time I went to Barbecue and Bourbon I tried the breaded tenderloin and thought is was very good - especially for $6 (Mondays).

The second time I tried the chicken fingers plate. The chicken fingers were very good - obviously fresh, not frozen - the cornbread was a little dry. For sides I got the baked beans and fried cabbage. The cabbage was just ok but the baked beans were delicious - sweet and a little spicy.

The third time I tried the pulled pork sandwich. OMG!!! It was so good that it did not need any sauce. But their sauces are so good that I added a little.

Did I mention that their sauces are amazing? My guilty pleasure is to put each sauce on each potato chip.

This last time the owner came by with a plate of the bacon that he had just made. Wow! I've never had smoked bacon before but it was so good that I can't wait until it makes the menu.

I don't tend to write reviews about my favorite restaurants - fearing that they will become too crowded but the food is so good that I can't contain myself.

I love Giovanni's Pizza and this review is way overdue. This place is amazing. Delicious pizza, but delicious everything else. Their cheese steaks are fantastic, steak or chicken. Both wonderful fare. I love the sandwiches and adore the stromboli choices. All SO good! Panzaratti is great and their meatball sandwich is like kissing the face of God. Just superb! The great things is, you can just go there and eat and watch sports and they even have a bar!

But my most favorite thing about Giovanni's is their delivery service. I work at a business in Rittenhouse and when I'm there at night and feeling a bit peckish, I hit up Giovanni's. 
The service is always, fast, fresh, and hot when i get it. Any little deatil I want about my food is always met perfectly. 
The delivery guys are on point and fast and friendly.
I get food from Giovanni's a couple of times a week and it is ALWAYS consistently fantastic. Fresh, hot and delicious! 

Bravo guys. Thank you so much for keeping me fed, and being the best food spot in the city!

You guys ROCK!

Charles - Megasun Tans and Megafit Personal Fitness

I have been there three times now. Service is not good. Portions are as small as I have ever seen. The tacos are so small you would think they came off a check Loren's menu. Same with the burritos. Salsa was ok, I prefer something with a little more spice but I realize you have to please the masses. But will not go back due to portion sizes. The only thing I have had there that was tasty and a good portion size was the Nachos.

Overall experience was good well organized and on time. The experience was very informative, nice and relaxing. Food was good and fresh. Server was nice and attentive. Photos of Nola from the boat in the evening sunset are very nice. Would recommend!

Excellent food, Garlic Twists are why they get a four.  The pizza was better than average.  I would eat here again.  Really, the 3 rating- no credit cards.  I was a bit taken back when they said cash only.
I was impressed by the steak prices so I had the 3 steak combo. I would have given this place 5 stars accept for the overcooked Ribeye which I didn't eat. All in all will definitely return.
Great!  I eat here 2-3 times a week now.  Lunch special kills it.  Such a good deal.  Healthy.  Lots of options.  And also delicious.

Very disappointed. It wasn't too long ago when this was an outstanding Subway. My husband and I have traveled all around the country and have been to many Subways but no one came close to this one. Now all of a sudden they have become the worst. The last couple of times we ordered a tuna sub the girl behind the counter put such a small amount of tuna on that you could actually see the bread in many spots. Usually they put three scoops of tuna on a foot long but she put one on and then scooped half of that back, on the same size sandwich. You couldn't even tell there was tuna in it. Our neighbor told us yesterday that they did the very thing to her with the tuna, at the same subway. I hope they change back to the way they were...they are starting to lose their best customers.

This particular Five Guys is a reason why the corporate model works.  I've been in locations from Pennsylvania to Miami, and the taste, quality, and service are the same and very consistent.  My favorite burgers are a toss-up between Five Guys and In-n-Out (and we're a long way from one of them on the east coast!).  The burgers are juicy, with a tasty bun, and wrapped the right way to hold heat and melt cheese.  Yeah, they give you a ton of fries, but they're good.  And if you don't want to eat a ton, then don't!  Given all of this and meat quality, there is no comparison to any of the fast-food outlets.

Great beer selection, food and very friendly staff.  

Had an engaging conversation with the GM (Matt?) who was a very cool dude.  Gave me the history of the place and telling me what was good to order.  Made the experience even better.  

I ordered their 'Donkey Cheesesteak' which was a special.  This was superb and a great twist on the Philly Cheesesteak.  I paired this with a Philly Gose beer and it was one of the best meals I had in Philly.

I highly recommend checking this place out.

Hate to take it down to 4 stars as this is usually a 5 star joint. They must have had an off day.  While  the pizza is still delicious,  I  took off one star because the pizza wasn't cut through, there were  a lot of big bubbles in the dough, the one that leaves you with a big bare spot as far as toppings go. And lastly they forgot the sourcream that usually comes with the chicken enchilada pizza.

Good seafood and good service.  Ordered the oyster bar trash & shrimp embroschette. Both were well poked and had lots of flavor. Service was good although it was slightly past lunch hour. Had someone bring me the crab cakes and again, lots of flavor.

I LOVE Han Dynasty! The food here is amazing and the service is pretty good. I've been to the Ucity and Old City in Philly and like the Ucity one much better. My only bummer about this past visit was I felt their portions were very different from the past. I felt like I got half the food I usually do for the same price.

10 Stars if I could do it... I fell in love with New Orleans at this oyster bar. Chuck was incredible company. By far the best crawfish I have ever had. We visited out of season and still experienced fresh big incredibly seasoned crawfish. The oysters are another highlight. "Chuckalucka the Mother Shucker" shucks them right in front of you. Very meaty and clean. The entire experience was a pleasure from start to finish. We returned the next day and will definitely be back again.

I had lunch with about 16 friends on a Saturday afternoon, and without exception, we were pleased.  The food was exceptional. My husband and I tried the Tom Yum soup, the satay appetizer, the pad thai and the fried rice.  We thought everything other than the fried rice was special; you know a little out of the ordinary compared to what we have eaten at other places.  The tofu satay was perfectly made, and the vegetarian spring rolls were really tasty.  Dessert included nibbles of coconut ice cream, a fried chocolate banana and the sticky mango rice.  I highly recommend the coconut ice cream.  Sticky mango is one of my favorite treats, and this was excellent. But the friend banana was pretty close to what I have had elsewhere (except I never had friend banana with a splash of chocolate tlike this). 

As to other issues, here is the run down: parking was available in a nearby free parking lot; the wait service was friendly and service was quick; the atmosphere was perfect for quiet two-person conversation and large group atmosphere; and the prices were moderate.

I highly recommend this restaurant.

Totally overrated. 

Food doesn't taste good. Beef noodle was over-cooked; beef not tender. Sausage Bento box's sausage super greasy. 

I suspect the good reviews are fake. 

Maybe good for Reno but no where close to good in authentic Chinese/Taiwanese food standard.

Had the Cajun Ribeye.  It is to die for.   We had to be in the area for work.  It just so happened it was our 33 wedding anniversary.  We normally go to the Capital Grille in Pittsburgh.  Sincerely we're here thought we would try something new.  Very good choice.

I have been going here for 4 years, a few times a year and the food, experience and staff are top notch. I cannot say anything bad or negative about the place, only positive. 
One of the best steaks i have ever eaten

I've come here for happy hour and quizzo a few times, and it's always been pretty darn good. 

The margaritas are tasty and strong, and for the happy hour price, you can't beat it. I also love the $1 PP endless chips & salsa. It's a great yummy, cheap snack to share with friends.

I have had a few of the menu selections including the mac & cheese (awesome), pulled pork (tasty) and pork belly. The pork belly was not my favorite. I'm hoping maybe it was just an off day, but the pork belly was very chewy and flavorless. I probably would not order that again.

This is definitely one of my favorite happy hours in the city. There's plenty of seating indoors & out, good service, strong drinks and great prices.

The best Mediterranean restaurant in the area. Everything from the fresh food to the great service. Real genuine place. Great experience all around. I highly recommend the mixed grill and there hummus is fantastic. They're very generous on there proportions as well. They're on uber eats as well if you don't feel like leaving home.

A solid 4.5 star in my opinion, which is great for a restaurant in it's first week of operation.  I'd be anxiously awaiting this location as the original in St. Pete has always been a favorite of mine. Getting a reservation on Open Table was easy and we were seated quite quickly despite the restaurant being at capacity and having a wait once we arrived.  Our server seemed to be pretty scarce throughout our time here and it took a while to place and even receive our drink orders.  We ordered the Meatballs as an appetizer and requested it come out before the entrees, which was verified by our server as she took our food orders at the same time.  

Nevertheless, the appetizer arrived no less than a minute before our entrees came out.  Not sure if this was a kitchen issue or if our server had just forgotten.  For my entrée I had the Chicken Fried Chicken Parm, which turned out to be a generous portion and cooked very well.  The chicken was crisp and not soggy like some places and it was overall a great dish.  I can't wait to try this place out again and for brunch sometime soon as well.

We went here simply because my son's name is Chase. Reviews were low but the place was great! Had a Moscow mule poured by an entertaining bartender who's worked there 30 years so was good for recommendations. I went with his and got the chicken piccata and was not disappointed. Little pricey though

One of my favorite places to get a pie, clean and friendly staff helps make your dining experience awesome. Be sure to get cheesy bread, which isn't on the menu but really should be because it's a great way to start your meal. Wash it down with one of their great beers on tap and you'll be a happy camper, go!

The breakfast had a lot of choices, and there price is fair. They had a nice verity. Fruits and meat, they even had some lunch stuff out for those who wanted something other than breakfast.  I would go back again, next time im in Reno.

Called up and was greeted by a very nice woman, Helped me to decide what dish I wanted. Perfectly seasoned, spicy wonderful green curry with chicken. 

Vegetables were perfectly cooked, spices were balanced wonderfully with this sweetish  basil coconut and spicy green chilies. What a treat. The perfect ending to a long hard day. I will definitely be back to try the other curries.. I ordered for take out and seriously considered going down to hug the chef this was so good.. Thank You!!

Drove out of our way to come to this place because we remembered it being pet friendly before and after searching for a parking spot for over 15 minutes we walk in and are informed that they are no longer allowing dogs unless they are service animals.  Pet owners beware...don't waste your time unless your dog is certified as a service animal.

Awesome food with a slight twist!!  I ordered the suizo burrito thinking it would be a green burrito...it was smothered in Alfredo and cilantro sauce (hence "suizo" instead if suiza).  Looked weird but it was amazing!  The Asada tacos had some kind of mildly spicy cream sauce that also looked weird but was amazing!  I can't wait to try their breakfast and go back.  As am extra bonus, the service was fast and friendly and it's at a very convenient location.  Score!!

I love Pi, simple enough. 

I expected to like their pizza based on recommendations and somehow it still exceeded my expectations. If you haven't tried it, do it. Great food with nice service and atmosphere.

I'm a big fan of Rostizado! Eating there multiple times during lunch and dinner I've refined my selections and found my favorites on the menu. 

#1 is the rotisserie pork platter. Although the chicken is their staple I'd say skip it for the more flavourful and fatty pork. The platter comes with some veg, slow roasted potatoes, and dipping sauces so it's a meal in itself and big enough to feed 2 adults. 

I'll often go with a starter but I find they are slightly overpriced so instead I get the house fried tortilla chips with multiple salsas. There's also deep fried pork skin in the chips order and they are the gems in the basket. 

Finally I always have the churros. They are a great balance between chewy, crispy, and cinnamony and the chocolate sauce adds the right amount of sweetness.
Love this place in New Orleans! The gumbo is amazing with the crab legs. The people are so nice! Located in Treme and much better than the tourist spots.

This was my first time at Minato Noodles. Visited for lunch and was happy to be seated right away. The ambience is plain, but clean. I was with my 9 year old so was disappointed to learn they do not have a child-size portions menu. I ordered the Donkatsu Udon and the server suggested ordering extra noodles ($2 more) and share the udon bowl. You can have the breaded pork on the side or in the noodle bowl. The server brought an additional little bowl when she served us. The udon was delicious, particularly the broth. I asked for the pork in the noodle bowl, which enhanced the flavor of both the the pork and the noodles. My 9yo loved the noodles and drank all the broth. I feel like the meal was a little overpriced at $10.99 for the bowl (+ $2 for extra noodles), but it does fill you up.  You can call for take-out though they don't have paper take-out menus. Definitely will go back and would recommend to friends!

My husband & I dined here last Friday evening (for the first time), and everything was amazing. AMAZING. 

For apps, we shared the brussels sprouts & squid. The brussels were probably the greatest thing I have *ever* tasted. I have been craving them like crazy ever since, and trying to recreate them at home (unsuccessfully!). I would visit P&K again and again just for the brussels. The squid was pretty good, but maybe a little too busy for my taste. A little less may have been a little more with this dish - but we definitely enjoyed it. 

As for the entrees, I had the Wagyu Bavette, and my husband the Monkfish. Both were INCREDIBLE. The Monkfish was served over the most deliciously prepared fennel - such a perfect pairing for this dish. As for the Wagyu - need I say more? Who doesn't love Wagyu Beef? It was cooked to perfection (med-rare) and served on the most delicious bed of farro and root veg salad. YUM.

Topped it all off with Panna Cotta and couldn't have been happier. We will be back very soon for sure!
As a New England transplant to the area it is a pleasure to find a family owned businesses that cater to quality in the community. I had one of the best cronuts I've ever had here.

Was here with a reserved group.  Was very noisy, took the server quite a while to get our check (was one that we all paid together)  Love the one downtown but the food here was not very good.  Chips were soggy and salsa no kick.  Have been here before and was good food and service.  Seems this location is quite inconsistent on food and service.

My husband and I decided to bring my parents to Ruth's Chris Steak House after purchasing a living social deal.  I must admit, I was a little hesitant to go after reading the Yelp reviews.  But, I must say, I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of food.  

I ordered the lobster tail and asked our waiter his suggestion for a side dish.  His favorite side dish was the broiled tomatoes and assured me I would like it as well.  Well, he was right.  The tomato was large, ripe and seasoned with salt and sugar.  It was delicious.  The lobster tail was equally good.  My mother and husband ordered the salmon with sautéed spinach and potatoes au gratin.  The potatoes were very rich and flavorful.  My husband was disappointed with the sautéed spinach - it was tasteless.  My father ordered the New York Strip (medium) and raved about how it was one of the best steaks he's ever had. He also ordered the potatoes lyonaisse as a side dish and found it satisfying.  

Aside from the tasteless spinach, everyone was very happy with their entrée choice. Unfortunately, dessert was skipped as we were too full from our meal so we'll have to try it on our next visit to Ruth's Chris.

We were looking for a good seafood place after our manatee swim. The zig zag scallop appetizer was amazing as were the fresh-cut french fries.  It's a little off the beaten path, but well worth the drive.  We would highly recommend stopping by.

The food was delicious! We ordered the Peruvian Classico, the scallops, and the salmon. Everything was so tasty and the scallops were cooked perfectly. The only downside was that it was loud. Granted, it was a busy night, but our table of four could barely hear each other talk. I'll definitely go back for the food; maybe on a less busy night.

Me and my husband are here right now and we ordered the Nutella banana dessert. It was delicious. Customer service is great! They are laid back and make you feel welcome! The restaurant itself is cute but the music that plays ruins the romance on a date. Overall good price and good food! Definitely coming here again!

Located in an older part of town in the Meadowlark Shopping Centre (a not so great area) but it wasn't chosen by me. The atmosphere was nice and I liked their patio set up.  Friendly waitress and excellent service.

I have always wanted to try this place out since I have one relatively close to me in Oliver Square (104 Ave).  I ordered one of their summer specials, a blackened steak sandwich (?) and an onion soup instead of fries.  I found it to be pretty tasty.  I would go back to try some other items on the menu but probably next time will be the Oliver location.

My husband and I go often to this restaurant. He loves indian food. Their lunch buffet is pretty economic although I think they should make the buffet menu vary from day to day. It's always the same, good but it certainly gets boring. 
Their menu chicken Korma is out if this world!, so is the naan.

LOVE LOVE LOVE Smileys! Came here instead of waiting in the long lines at the food trucks during the Manayunk strEAT food festival. Got the beef platter and it comes with so much food for the price! It came with beef, rice, Greek salad, hummus and pita! I shared with my BF and it filled us up. I wanted to try their smoothies but didn't want to wait in line again. They have seating in the back which is comfy. Delicious and fresh! Will have to come back again when I'm in the area!

It was late afternoon a cloudy day.  I drove way the hell up here from tesson ferry and 270 to buy a book.  I was hungry so I yelped the area and here I am.  I hate this area, endless malls and difficult left turns.  

The place is a hole in the wall.  Eight tables facing cars moving, parked and junked.  I was stunned to be greeted at the counter by an attractive, slender and slightly tattooed and pierced young blonde.  Two tables were occupied by what appeared to be regulars.  The menu had several pages but the host directed me to the lunch specials.  It was divided in two selections, the meat and the stir fried vegetables.  You are able to swap ingredients.  Great selections, I chose yellow curried veggies and the seafood.  It also came with a nice small soup and two tiny disappointing fried egg roles.  I like the soft kind.  

The soup and rolls came within a good time frame and the main dish quickly followed.  I identified shrimp, clams and scallops.  There was more I couldn't name.  It was very good.  All throughout, the host engaged her clients with token banter, the men, including myself tried to shine our macho/gentleman wiles.  Decades, I'm sure, separated us from the host.  She convinced me to spend more on fried bananas and mango ice cream, this too was delicious.  

As the end neared the host continued her sugary words.  A perfunctory inquiry into the rest of my day elicited my need to study.  She wasn't in school, I hope she does, her tattoos and piercing belies her perky sensibility as well as my old fashioned sense of aesthetics.  She asked if I would return, I replied I would if she would be here to greet me.  Total cost: entree, soda, dessert, tax and tip $23.

Excellent service - delicious food!!   Easy walk from area hotels and shopping- totally worth it.    Casual atmosphere with good tunes and great drink selections!

Wish this place was in Dallas so I could enjoy more often!   Chicken tacos were delicious

I was driving by, and decided to give it a try.  The dining room is kind of noisy.  But I like the homey feel.  The server was attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable of the menu, which has a lot of good choices.

I ordered the cheeseburger with bacon.  It came out exactly as I ordered it, medium, hot and good.  The burger was served on toasted thick bread, different, but it works well here.  The fresh dill pickle reminded me of El Cap, and I loved it, I only wished they would of served two slices to complete the burger, as one did not seem to cover the whole burger.

After I was served, the owner/chef, came out and asked me if it was o.k., I appreciate the genuine concern by the owner, to find out if I was satisfied, something you do not get often these days.  

The choice of french fries or tater tots was a good change of pace too.  I opted for the tater tots.  They were hot, a little over cooked for my taste, but some may like crispy, good never the less.

A surprise here, and Ill be back to try the Cuban!

I came here for dinner with my girlfriend on Valentine's Day.  I thought the service was outstanding.  I liked the decor of the restaurant, and the food was great.  We started off with a bottle of wine and the fried calamari, which was easily the best calamari I've ever had.  I would definitely recommend that as an appetizer.  For dinner we got Chicken Parmesan and Rigatoni Vodka, which is nothing adventurous, but both meals were great.  The portions were also big enough for each of us to have leftovers for the next night.  I definitely left here a fan of this place.  The only reason it loses a star is because the food is a little overpriced.

Many times I ordered a bowl with one entry. But what I got was a bowl full of white rice but very little entry. This is my firsthand experience. I had the similar review on another Panda Express, just because I had the same experience there. I will not choose these places any more.
Eh- I was hungry, it was alright. I looked for something savory in the menu and got healthy instead. Nice staff, would visit again if I was in the area and really hungry

I grew up in Chicago where i loved the local Gyro shops.  After leaving Chicago some ten or so years ago i have been on the look out for a Gyro that was even half as good!  Not until i walked into Sunrise Cafe and ordered one have I not been utterly disappointing.  TRULY AWESOME GYRO and for the love of all things that taste good do NOT forget the house made green hot sauce it is to DIE FOR !!!! i go through the stuff like its cold water.

Situated over a natural spring and along the inner bay, this is a beautiful location to relax and get away. Spa services are excellent.  Staff is friendly and does a very good job of making you feel pampered. They use Aveda products (which I love!) I recommend looking through the many pkgs they offer for the resort. If you're a local, you may want to check out the mother &daughter day, week day, couples day, gentelmen's day, full day, or 1/2 day pkgs w/o accomodations.

I brought my son here been here the garlic potatoes were gritty tasting like it was mixed with instant potatoes and it just wiped out my taste buds the watress not friendly at all i did talk to the manager and ask him if he tasted those potatoes  or the chef they should not have even been served they offered me no money off my bill and i will never ever ever eat here again should be shut down
Great spot, awesome drink selection and friendly, accommodating staff. Good for lunch and dinner. Will definitely be back. The Ahi sandwich was amazing!

Definitely a good new addition to our neck of the woods. I don't know why it took me so long to visit since this location opened a few months ago, but I'm glad we stopped in recently. The dining room was clean and well kept, and the staff was very friendly and accommodating. Our food was delivered promptly. The taco salads are insanely huge (gotta love the tortilla bowl too), and my husband was happy with his carnitas burrito. I'm sure we'll be back very soon!

Delicious. Fresh. Filling!
I love the Seafood pizza which comes loaded with shrimp, calamari, mussels, and clams on baked dough with olive oil, garlic and cheese! A girlfriend of mine comes over regularly and we just order this as take out and veg at home with our pizza and wine!

Absolutely the best customer service you will ever enjoy at at a quality Sushi restaurants.  Tommy is great and will spoil you with delicacies only found in the best sushi restaurants in the world: Sharon and Donna are a joy to have as your servers . . . . . You simply must try this place. . . . Be nice. . Be friendly. . . . Ask questions and enjoy!!!

2.5 stars at best. We came here after a 2 hour drive into Reno and I was STARVING. I wanted to go to the Atlantis buffet based on yelp reviews but had a hard time coughing up $30 for seafood because I don't like seafood. It seemed like most places have a seafood buffet on a Friday night so when I found this place for $13.99, it was a done deal. 

First, the line was really long. At 9 pm, there were probably 20 people ahead of us in line but it was moving fairly quickly until I realized that that was just the line to pay. Then you have to stand in a separate line to get seated. I waited in line for over 40 minutes and the entire time, I stared at an entirely empty seating area and willed them to open that area up. They never did. 

Then we got seated and I ran for the food. At first glance, there seems to be a huge selection with a seafood, Italian, Chinese, meat carving stations and cold cut stations and I was able to get at least a few pieces of each station. This is my normal buffet strategy. I pick up 1-2 pieces of everything so that I can strategize for my second round. It was a really bad sign when the only thing I put on my plate the second time around was brussel sprouts and fried noodles. The food just wasn't good. A lot of their items were extremely salty, especially the clam chowder. I guess In retrospect, I don't know what I was expecting when I decided to go to a $13.99 seafood buffet. The king crab legs were rubbery on the outside and hard to crack open. Blah. 

The dessert section was huge but nothing amazing there either. I left feeling regret, which is normally how I feel after buffets, but definitely more regret than normal. I think I'll shell out the $30 next time for some better quality food.

I've tried deep dish pizza in Chicago, as well as deep dish pizza in my home state of California.  Pi's pizza encompassed the aspects that I like from each deep dish pizza I've tried in the past.  The cheese to tomato ratio perfect here (sometimes deep dish pizza is comparable to drinking a can of tomato sauce), and I liked that we were able to order a half/half pizza and try 2 flavors. We had leftovers, and they were still equally as delicious when we heated them up a few hours later. I can see why this is Obama's favorite pizza!

The food is good.  The gobi manchurian is particularly delicious.

Chicken vindaloo is good and naan is very good.

I've never been to Applebee's before.  I decided to stay with basics. I had a cheeseburger. You can have pink or not.  Keeping it simple is probably smart.  I thought the burger was really good in that charged edges smash burger kind of way. The waitress was very good and we were five people who really didn't know the menu or place. Good for them.
Incredible food, service, and vibe! Check out their Sunday buffet. Awesome selection that's fresh. A bit pricy but so worth it!!!

The fish is great, but the macaroni is straight out the box. For the prices they charge i expect something other than kraft mac n cheese. The jerk chicken is good. They raised their prices a lil while ago which sucks. I would probably go more often  if it were cheaper since I work across the street

The best French restaurant outside of Paris. At least thus far as we are planning to continue exploring. They serve the best French onion soup ever. Very large and tasty lamb chops. Excellent salad that you'll need to eat separately because of the lamb chops. Oh, ya, the bread is amazing as well.
Pulled pork, pulled chicken and beef brisket was amazing! Best brisket I have ever eaten. Great selection of sides and all were fresh. Great little place.

I am a huge fan of Bully's food. I think they have delicious pulled pork and sides, but their service tends to be slow and not good quality. We had our rehearsal dinner here and while the food was delicious, they only had one person working the entire back room (catering for about 40 people). Drinks were not being served, we ran out of food (even though we paid for it, it was very disorganized. I would definitely recommend eating here if you are looking for good bbq, but I think they need to reconsider their catering and poor service.

Absolutely terrible, ordered tickets that was to include dinner. We were there for 2 hours and never received our dinner, but they made sure we fulfilled the two drink minimum. I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone. Show mediocre at best.

Great locals bar with great burgers.  

It's a nice spot to hit up for lunch on a lazy Sunday and grab a beer and burger.

Being from Cincinnati and not having a skyline on every corner here in Tampa is hard. How ever the one we do have in the Tampa Bay Area will do when you just have to have it.  I feel like it's just not the same. Not sure what it is.  It's good just not the same. Maybe stuff is frozen or a different supplier or something.  But the coneys are good and the 3 ways are good.  Maybe it's the lack of crapy weather.. But all cincy people eat here..

Tried this place on our way home from Philly. Glad we stopped. Good Irish food and great service. Only negative was the acoustics in the place made the live music almost unbearable (band was very good). Will go back on a quiet night.
Chinks! The best cheesesteaks around. Can't even drive by without stopping because it smells soo good. I grew up with my parents taking me there and I'm still going there now

My husband and I came here for Memorial Day weekend. It was surprisingly not busy and my husband decided to come here based on the burger reviews. They helped us out fairly quickly. I was surprised a bit by the prices, yet I naively figured that it must mean the food is made with extra care. My husband ordered a burger and I ordered the roasted chicken. The burger, based on my husband's review, was delicious. My chicken, on the other hand, was a disaster. At first glance the chicken looked huge, so seeing some burned sections didn't bother me as much, that was until I noticed that what wasn't burned was pure bone. The couple of bites I took of it ended up being extremely dry and had no other flavor except for burnt. I mainly ate the mashed potatoes, which was also a disappointment, and considered the $22+ we spent on my meal alone, as a lost. Maybe I was unfortunate and the chef simply got distracted, yet for their meal prices I expected so much more. In regards to the service, like I mentioned, we got greeted and seated quickly. The only negative thing I saw was that some of the employees who I think had just ended their shift were sitting in the bar talking with the staff that was still on the clock and they complaint throughout our entire meal about their work and other guests. I didn't find it appropriate to be talking badly about previous guests while current ones were eating their dinner just 10 feet away.
Came here 7/2, @6pm, got seated, got drinks, got served, got dinner, all good, no problems as with other reviews.Good meal, good service, good time. Good night and good bye!

we stopped here Friday night for something different.  they have  very very good, inexpensive seafood.  Everything is cooked to order.  I had the Maryland crab cakes, and they were Delicious.  the Calamari app was not what i was expecting however is wasn't bad.  I will definitely go back.

The worst fried chicken I've ever had. The nastiest/saltiest mac and cheese I've ever had. I almost vomited after eating my food. I will never visit this place again. I'll stick to home cooked or Sweetie Pies.

I am an ex-server for olive garden. It is one of my favorite restaurants and I drove over half an hour to eat there with two of my friends on Thursday may 31st. Our servers were Tracey and mikayla, whose was training, and I was extremely disappointed in the service that we recieved.
I'd like to highlight first the some service that met the outstanding expectations that I know olive garden expects.
When we arrived we were seated right away and our server in training introduced herself fairly quickly. We were given adequate time to look at the menu and make our selections. Our first round of salad and bread sticks, along with our appetizer very quickly. After this though the whole atmosphere and attitude seemed to change.
Our tray of breadsticks and salad stood empty for almost 20 minutes after that initial  round. One of the reasons I love olive garden is because of the refills on salad, soup, and breadsticks. While we waited on someone to recognize that we needed refills, a tray of dirty dishes sat out in the dining room for approximately 30 minutes across from our table. Our main courses came out before our second round of salad and breadsticks and when I recieved my entree the sauce in the ravioli de portabellas that I had ordered congealed and the entree was cold. I flagged down a server as no one had asked us how are meal was. Although my meal was replaced with no question, it came out after both of my friends were finished eating and had recieved to-go boxes, so I was eating my meal alone. After we were all done eating, everything was boxed up, and dishes were cleared we then waited over another 15 minutes for my dessert to-go and our check. Finally when we did receive our check it was the wrong one. Thankfully I was planning on paying with a credit card so I didn't just leave money on the table and walk out. 
Again I am very disappointed in the service I recieved tonight. The problem with our service is that there was no direction from the server that was training the new employee. Tracey seemed to be more worried about a large party that was sitting behind us but made a point to mention in passing that mikayla better do good tonight because she was making her money. Now I understand the basis behind why trainees give their tips to their trainer, as I went through the training myself, but tracy was not guiding her, checking on the table or shadowing her anyway. I feel like mikayla was sent out to the wolves with no food.

Yat's is an incredible restaurant, filled with a cool, kinda weird New Orleans vibe, jazz music, pictures, and cajun memorabilia. The food is great, too. I love the Chill-Cheese Etouffee the best, as well as the Maque Choux. It's all good though! 
The owner is a great guy, who loves his restaurant and loves his patrons.

I visited the Café Fleur De Lis several years ago.  Alone in New Orleans, wandering the streets in the early morning hours, I chose the restaurant because it was cute, and having lived in Louisville, KY, the Fleur De Lis name seemed like a bit of home.  It was a great decision!  Despite the amount of time that has passed, I've never forgotten the Fleur de Lis omelet; it was so good.  I'd jump at the chance to visit NOLA, again, just to be able to return to the café for breakfast.

My love for Harry and Izzy's has no limits!!!!! If you want a wonderful dinner and experience this is a great place to dine. I love the fact that I am able to make reservations and have a table available immediately. I also love the variety in the menu, because when you go to more upscale places you don't see that often a variety in the menu. The service is always amazing and they also have a great dessert menu. I would recommend Harry and Izzy's if you want a date night or a night out with your family or if you have out of town guest visiting. They don't disappoint!!!!!!!

My husband first noticed the wood floors. The restaurant has a great atmosphere. Our waiter, Charlie, could not have been any better!  He was awesome!  He noticed my husband looking at the beer list so Charlie explained it was happy hour (7 days a week, 3-6 PM) and told us about the $5 appetizers and drink specials.   Then he proceeded to tell us about the menu and how the tri-tip and rotisserie chicken was prepared. He made it all sound so great it was hard to choose. My husband got the chicken and tri-tip combo and I got  salmon risotto.  After trying the tri-tip and chicken we both agreed they were just as good as Charlie described: tender and moist prime rib and juicy chicken with crispy skin. Yum!!  The generous portion of risotto was surrounded by roasted veggies and topped with a very moist portion of salmon.  Their menu had my husband's favorite dessert--mud pie. So we had to splurge. The coffee ice cream was marbled with fudge and nuts.  Enough for us to share.  Our waiter was accommodating to a small change to a side dish and taught us a few things about the beer choices on their menu.  Great place, tasty food and excellent service.! Will definitely recommend it to my friends!
Food is overpriced and the menu online is not the same as the menu in the cafe.  The food is the same but the prices are vastly different.  False advertising. Not impressed.

The spice level is just right, numbing with heat, the Szechuan classics are correct, the West Philly location is lively with a full bar, and great prices. So why only 3 stars? Because each time I eat here, the happy post-meal glow is followed by the symptoms of MSG overdose. Headache, dry mouth, drowsiness, etc. Please, Han Dynasty, stop using or at least cut down on the MSG so I can love you without regrets!!!

No major complaints about the service, the ambiance, the view. I doubt I'll be suggesting anyone go out of their way to come here though. My NY strip was requested MR and came out the MW side of M. That is pretty much unacceptable in my book considering that I don't often go out looking to pay for steak.. and this is a steakhouse.

On a more positive note, the creme brulee was excellent for dessert, and my friend appeared to enjoy the sauce his mussels came in.

My husband and I were visiting Santa Barbara for our baby moon and had great meals the whole time we were here and decided to try Dawn Patrol for the great reviews. The ambience is super cool and chill and the menu looked good. I got the patrol combo, scrambled eggs with sausage and added a pancake while my husband got the breakfast burrito. The food was ok, my scrambled eggs were more like an omelette with no flavor, sausage had no flavor either and the garlic potatoes tasted a day old. The only good thing for me was the pancake and the fresh squeezed oj. My husband enjoyed his burrito but it was small compared to the price. I really wanted to like this place but if we visit SB again we won't be coming here.

Average-mediocre. There is a nickname for this place that seems is somewhat accurate. It's not the worst, but frequently food quality leaves much to be desired. It might depend on what you order. If you are hammered and need delivery, it's ok, but it's not going to impress a date. Food does not frequently taste like it is prepared fresh.

Sometimes the food delivered is worse quality, but others it's ok. Delivery is convenient.
Come on your one of the highest grossing casinos and you have to start charging $10 for parking and up your drink prices, I appreciate the memories hard rock but not cool

What a fantastic place to dine. Great food, wonderful atmosphere, cordial staff. Everything you could ask for in a dining establishment. Oh, how could I forget the varied selection of pies and cakes. I'll be back for more.
AWSOME breakfast went back for second round. The "Big Easy" wad the Busines!

Great food, great service ... Drove by this place a number of times and finally made it to the restaurant. The food is wonderful. I really like the deep-fried zucchini and the steak specials are great. My son had the ribs and steak combo and really liked the combo. The beans are tasty as is the coleslaw. I haven't tried their signature dessert yet ... We are usually too full to order dessert.

A treasure! So glad we found this wonderful little spot for breakfast (or lunch). Sweet casual decor, excellent menu choices and specials, attentive friendly staff. No gluten free bread yet, but they are hoping to add some when they find a good supplier.
They do have GF cookies in the meantime.
Loved the cheesy grits. Everything that went by looked fabulous!

I have to say that The Food Liaison is my favorite place to eat for lunch. There hasn't been one thing that I haven't loved! And the pastries! OMG don't get me started. The food is fresh, lunches healthy.....did I mention the desserts? 

My vote would be for The Food Liaison to be open longer and on the weekends!  Yes that request is to feed my Food Liaison addiction! :)

Best Chinese restaurant in Reno. We tried to go there before for dinner but the wait was insane. Got there right when they opened for lunch  and they quickly filled up after.

Great flavor for all dishes. Looooooved their stinky tofu...best dish of the day. Perfectly fried and seasoned. 

We had 8 dishes along w/ drinks and it only came out to around $60ish. 10% off w/ check in if you order over $40. Awesome!

We purchased the 8 piece fried chicken from the deli at 5:45pm. We assumed the chicken would be fresh since it was dinner time. Wrong!!  It was the smallest pieces of chicken we have ever seen and it was all dried out. One wing was so small that it only had a piece of a bone.  One thigh was dried out and was missing the crispy skin. It was just a piece of almost black dried meat.  We couldn't eat half the chicken it was so bad. Apparently there isn't any quality control in the deli. Very disappointing.

Greeted and seated promptly. 
Ordered the original sticky fingers. They were excellent. Great taste and cooked perfectly. 
Waitress was friendly. 
Great meal for the price.
Amazing food, nice ambience and commendable service. The prices are cheap. I'm a regular visitor. Their tacos are great, especially fish tacos. Fried fish is also great.

A gem in manayunk! Stopped in today for some breakfast and left satisfied. The sandwiches looked delicious, but I ordered the double down: 2 eggs, 2 french toast w/ sausage. The staff was very kind. It's small, so if you think of going with a large group, call first.

Delicious food!  The service was great , the maitre d' and our waitress were very friendly.  The bread is to die for, actually the bread all over New Orleans is to die for.  I ordered the roasted chicken and it melted in my mouth along with the mash potatoes.  Only complaint was that the air conditioning was on and it was freezing, but apparently it is a consistent problem that restaurant has with the hotel it is located in. Ohhh, almost forgot, the dessert. I can't remember the name but it was this chocolate, chicory, mousse type dessert, WOW! So good!
If what you want is really curry in a hurry, this place isn't bad. Not the most authentic Indian food ever, but considering the staff isn't Indian, it's not half bad. I like the naan.

I was surprised this little hole in the wall sushi place in the middle of no where was so good. Everything on the extensive menu looked and sounded very good. I was a little weary of the hibachi nature look of everything but it was really legit

I have a real hard time with this place. Last time they wouldn't let me in based on my shoes. (Your on Bourbon Street in WEM calm the shit down) This time the bouncer was much nicer and we got in. So we talked to the manager I assume about a couple things and he was great to deal with. However out waitress wasn't overly friendly.  I do not agree with 18%  At any place. Fine add 10% but the point of tips is for good service. I will tip 20% on average but dont push it on me. And WTF is an entertainment fee?? Your tipping to get a song played already. On that note they do deliver! The pianos are awesome! While the drink prices are great on hi balls the rest is steep. The food menu is similar great range of choice but steep. And to be honest it is only average food. No one complained but no one was amazed. So I am torn. I give it a 2.5/5 what is good is great what is not good is very meh....

My favorite part was the atmosphere! It was just what we were looking for: a non-touristy, innovative take on classic foods. The sliders were delicious, the house salad was to die for, and the Monte Christo was out of this world! 

Their famous donuts are gorgeous, each looking like pieces of art. 

The staff is friendly and welcoming. Lots of locals frequent here, tipping us off to a true find of a restaurant. 

As a creative, I would definitely make this a frequent stop if I was a local. It would be a great place to meet with friends, or to be inspired to write.

I ordered a salad for takeout and a grilled cheese for my kiddo. The prices were higher than I expected. Grilled cheese was cold and hard. They forgot the pickle. They forgot to make the chocolate drink. My "bread roll" was hard a a rock. The staff was not very pleasant. I won't return.

Worst BYOB I've been to ! Came in with a group and as we we're waiting for guests to arrive we asked for bread and were told we can't have bread until we order appetizers. The server never asked us if we wanted appetizers at the time. The server also told my friend to move into table closer two times, very rudely . The tables are like 3 inches apart to begin with! Food was not authentic! Lacked serious flavor! Blah! This is why I cook at home. Tiny cash only BYOB should be more welcoming
Good pizza! U can get different taste in here. Anyway, there are some Really good TW food.

We were in from out of town and so glad we went to this restaurant. It has a lovely vibe and our waitress was outstanding. I got the lobster risotto and while it was good - I would say it wasn't the most enticing dish I'd ever had. You get a dinner rolls with some interesting (tasty) hummus and salads were not part of the dish. We got the Caesar and again not the best I'd ever had or seen - but still.. We were comfortable, welcomed, and full when we left. Loved the location of this place the food was good - I wouldn't list it in the top Italian food ever category though. Give it a try!

Forget about atmosphere and ambiance, as this place is located under a parking garage and it definitely has a grimy kinda vibe to it.  When you enter the restaurant, you can't help but question the cleanliness of the place. I agree with the other posters who touted their breakfast sandwiches on long rolls.  I've had a bacon egg and cheese and a pork roll egg and cheese and the prices were very cheap for a good sandwich.  Sandwiches are one thing, but do yourself a favor and don't get the pizza.  I honestly think it's frozen and not made fresh on premises.  It was very bad quality pizza.

The food was great, but everything else was lacking.  We arrived on time for our 715pm reservation for a requested. quiet table for for. Upon arrival, Frank told us our table would not be ready for a half hour and we should wait at the bar. After awhile, when no one took our drink orders, other tables emptied and walk-ins were seated, we asked for another table. Frank told us that customers should request, not demand and that the entire staff was aware of us. (!?!). Eventually we were seated  next to a table for eight that took up most of the dining room exit/entry area and was about 3 inches from our table. Result? Every guest entering or leaving the restaurant and/ or rest room bumped into my chair, put their hands on my shoulders to squeeze by or asked me to move. Unpleasant in so many ways, will not return.

Taste good, lively atmosphere, respectful and friendly staff.

I had the cabeza caramelo, sonoran hot dog, and chiles ahogados.  Really tasty.

Five stars and all that, but what this review is mainly for is my disbelief that there isn't more mention of the pork liver pate.

Vegetarian is great and all, and the pork is a good standby, but if you want that perfect, illusive, and characteristically combined Vietnamese/French hybrid, do yourself a favor.

Pate Party 2k10

I went in July 2016 with my family. They ordered sandwiches which were okay, no rave. One salad order wrong. I ordered a chicken quesadilla. Horrible. I had to hunt for the few pieces of chicken and they used a yellow cheese, not real sure but I think cheddar. Clumpy and cold. And no ocean view. Parked WAY down the road so forget handicap or elderly. There was a tiki bar that had 'stay out' yellow tape and a sign warning 'no kids'. Of course children kept going in and one of my party rescued them until the parents noticed. Poor way to insure customer safety.

We had wings, brisket and the C Rock special. Delicious and tender!!! The service was good. The vibe was great - this is clearly the spot where the locals go on a Friday night. Can't wait to go back and hang out on the patio. I wish it was closer to my home but well worth the travel.

Rincon events catered my wedding in March of this year. They did an excellent job!  Angie was so helpful from beginning to end. The food was amazing and the staff was very professional.  They even made us a meal to go and boy was I hungry when I got home.  Can't say enough about this wonderful company!

I am writing about the precinct pizza in New Tampa, owned by the same person. Last week ordered 2 pizzas one plain and the other with toppings. Specifically told the employee slightly well done and not too thick. When I got the pizzas home, they were thick doughy and undercooked. Not even close to NY style pizza. Wasted 37 dollars. Believe me, as an Italian New Yorker, this place is awful. Will never go back. The pizza is awful.

This is my all time favorite Greek restaurant! Great food, service and pricing.  Many choices for Greek cuisin in Tarpon but this is definitely one of the top places to eat while you're in the sponge docks!
Great coffee and food! Ask for the Monica Kelly - a healthy bagel with veggies and added lox for a great meal anytime of day.

Carlota's on Lambert in O.V. is about as authentic as you can get! The first hint is the Salsa and chips which appears quickly by friendly and efficient staff. The menu is extensive and has about 5 soups, for example.

Yes, service is a bit slow. The reason is simple. They make it from scratch. But the short wait is worth it. Piping hot, well seasoned, tasty dishes are the hallmark at Carlota's!

Had the Steak and Broccoli rabe with bacon and sharp provolone! The wife had The chicken pizza Awesome! Got a couple Hoagies for later tonight. Had it delivered to our Semi through Yelp. Service was good and food was Delicious!

This is my new favorite place. I've been there about 5 times - once was at 7:30 am and I got a great drink recommended by the bartender. It was a pint of hard cider with a shot of fireball whiskey - REALLY good! They have good vegan food at affordable prices with big servings. The veggie wrap is GREAT and NOT boring like most veggie wraps can be, AND it was a big, normal portion size and not the typical you're-a-vegan-so-you-obviously-don't-need-your-money's-worth size. My boyfriend had some kind of bacon/shrimp/cheesey grits plate that he loved. I've always found the service to be good and the workers to be super friendly. I love the decor and it's crazy funky upstairs.
Awesome breakfast/lunch spot! Potato Cakes are the truth. You will not be disappointed.

This is a classic is school steak house experience. The Prime Rib is particularly delicious and enormous. Been around for a long time and it feels like it in a good way. Big steaks. Stiff drinks. Low pretense. What's not to love?

I have been going to this place for a about 2 years now. The food is great with a great menu. You have an option of about 10 quesadillas. However, you can make each quesadilla a wrap. The buffalo chicken wrap did not impress me. I usually get the Aztec. One thing that stops this place from getting 5 stars is the the price. It is a little expensive for what you get. I would think they would give you a free side of salsa or sour cream, but that's extra!

I've been here twice and the service is always exceptional! All of the beers are delicious and you've got to try their kolsche! However, the food is really hit or miss. I went with the daily chicken sandwich special and it was not good. I let the waiter know that I didn't want my food and they took it back, insisted on getting me something else to eat. I politely declined and just asked for another beer and they comped it. I will always come back to the Bottleworks when I'm in town! They have really fun events and their beer is extraordinary!

My food was great on my first visit!
Amazing price point; great, quality ingredients. Love they have crust options of wheat, gluten free, and now cauliflower. I like that they grow with the current trends.

Their service is amazing.   I ordered a pizza for delivery. (Love their pizza.)  The order was inadvertently written as a pickup.  I called and they apologize.  However they offered to make me a new one and deliver it all free of charge.  I am really impressed.

The service and the drink was good, but that is where it ends.  I ordered the Falafel plate.  It came with a teaspoon of hummus, 3 falafels, pita, some roasted veggies, and some nasty grain. I tried to make the most of it and asked from some more hummus.  I was given another teaspoon (not tablespoon).  So my falafels were dry.  It was a 17 dollar horrible meal.  I left unsatisfied so we went to another place so I could actually eat.  Good drinks but don't get the falafels unless you hate hummus.

Hands down the best restaurant in New Orleans!

Crispy brussel sprouts appetizer was good, very saucy, not bitter.

Lump crab appetizer was pretty good.
